### `app/api/dashboard/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser, getSyndicResidenceIds, getResidentApartmentIds, getResidentResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Role, IncidentStatus, ChargeStatus, AnnouncementAudience, AnnouncementStatus } from "@/types/enums";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Charge } from "@/models/Charge";
import { Payment } from "@/models/Payment";
import { Expense } from "@/models/Expense";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { Announcement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import AnnouncementRead from "@/models/AnnouncementRead";
import { Notification } from "@/models/Notification";
import { getTechnicianResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { publishedAnnouncementFilter } from "@/lib/announcements/visibility";
import { getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence, getReadCountsByAnnouncement } from "@/lib/announcements/readStats";
import { publishDueAnnouncements } from "@/lib/announcements/publication";

/**
 * GET /api/dashboard
 * Endpoint unique retournant les métriques et chiffres adaptés selon le rôle connecté :
 * - ADMIN / SYNDIC : KPI (taux recouvrement, trésorerie, incidents ouverts, impayés) + graphiques
 * - RESIDENT : Ce que je dois, dernières annonces, mes incidents
 * - TECHNICIAN : Mes interventions (assignées, en cours, résolues)
 */
export const GET = withAuth(
  async (_req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. SYNDIC & ADMIN
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      let residenceFilter: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      let residenceIds: string[] = [];

      if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
        residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
        residenceFilter = { residence: { $in: residenceIds } };
      }
      await publishDueAnnouncements(user.role === Role.ADMIN ? null : residenceIds);

      // Lots de la copropriété
      const aptIds = await Apartment.find(residenceFilter).distinct("_id");
      const currentMonth = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);

      // Charges du mois et taux de recouvrement
      const [monthChargeSummary] = await Charge.aggregate<{ totalAmount: number; totalPaid: number }>([
        { $match: { apartment: { $in: aptIds }, period: currentMonth } },
        { $group: { _id: null, totalAmount: { $sum: "$amount" }, totalPaid: { $sum: "$paidAmount" } } },
      ]);
      const totalMonthAmount = monthChargeSummary?.totalAmount ?? 0;
      const totalMonthPaid = monthChargeSummary?.totalPaid ?? 0;

      const collectionRate =
        totalMonthAmount > 0
          ? Math.round((totalMonthPaid / totalMonthAmount) * 100)
          : 100;

      // Trésorerie = Recettes encaissées - Dépenses
      const chargeIds = await Charge.find({ apartment: { $in: aptIds } }).distinct("_id");
      const [paymentSum] = await Payment.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
        { $match: { charge: { $in: chargeIds } } },
        { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: "$amount" } } },
      ]);
      const [expenseSum] = await Expense.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
        { $match: residenceFilter },
        { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: "$amount" } } },
      ]);

      const totalPayments = paymentSum?.total || 0;
      const totalExpenses = expenseSum?.total || 0;
      const treasury = Math.round((totalPayments - totalExpenses) * 100) / 100;

      // Incidents ouverts
      const incFilter: Record<string, unknown> = {
        status: { $in: [IncidentStatus.REPORTED, IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED, IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS] },
      };
      if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) incFilter.residence = { $in: residenceIds };
      const openIncidents = await Incident.countDocuments(incFilter);

      // Impayés globaux
      const [unpaidChargeSummary] = await Charge.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
        { $match: { apartment: { $in: aptIds }, status: { $in: [ChargeStatus.PENDING, ChargeStatus.PARTIAL, ChargeStatus.OVERDUE] } } },
        { $addFields: { remainingAmount: { $subtract: [{ $ifNull: ["$amount", 0] }, { $ifNull: ["$paidAmount", 0] }] } } },
        { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $gt: ["$remainingAmount", 0] }, "$remainingAmount", 0] } } } },
      ]);
      const unpaidAmount = Math.round((unpaidChargeSummary?.total ?? 0) * 100) / 100;

      // Graphique 1 : Recettes vs Dépenses par mois (6 derniers mois)
      const months: string[] = [];
      const now = new Date();
      for (let i = 5; i >= 0; i--) {
        const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1);
        months.push(d.toISOString().slice(0, 7));
      }

      // Agrégation dépenses par mois
      const expensesByMonth = await Expense.aggregate<{ _id: string; total: number }>([
        { $match: residenceFilter },
        {
          $group: {
            _id: { $substr: [{ $dateToString: { date: "$expenseDate" } }, 0, 7] },
            total: { $sum: "$amount" },
          },
        },
      ]);
      const expMap = new Map(expensesByMonth.map((e) => [e._id, e.total]));

      // Agrégation paiements par mois
      const paymentsByMonth = await Payment.aggregate<{ _id: string; total: number }>([
        { $match: { charge: { $in: chargeIds } } },
        {
          $group: {
            _id: { $substr: [{ $dateToString: { date: "$paymentDate" } }, 0, 7] },
            total: { $sum: "$amount" },
          },
        },
      ]);
      const payMap = new Map(paymentsByMonth.map((p) => [p._id, p.total]));

      const financialByMonth = months.map((m) => {
        const dateObj = new Date(m + "-01");
        const monthLabel = dateObj.toLocaleDateString("fr-FR", { month: "short" });
        return {
          month: monthLabel,
          period: m,
          recettes: Math.round((payMap.get(m) || 0) * 100) / 100,
          depenses: Math.round((expMap.get(m) || 0) * 100) / 100,
        };
      });

      // Graphique 2 : Incidents par statut
      const managedIncidentFilter = user.role === Role.SYNDIC
        ? { residence: { $in: residenceIds } }
        : {};
      const [
        roleCounts,
        residenceCount,
        incidentCounts,
        publishedAnnouncementCount,
        scheduledAnnouncementCount,
        announcementTrendRows,
        urgentIncidents,
        latestAnnouncements,
        workloadRows,
        latestNotifications,
      ] = await Promise.all([
        user.role === Role.ADMIN
          ? User.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
              { $match: { isActive: true } },
              { $group: { _id: "$role", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
            ])
          : Promise.resolve([]),
        Residence.countDocuments(user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? { _id: { $in: residenceIds } } : {}),
        Incident.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
          { $match: managedIncidentFilter },
          { $group: { _id: "$status", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
        ]),
        Announcement.countDocuments({
          ...residenceFilter,
          ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
          status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED,
          publishedAt: { $lte: new Date() },
        }),
        Announcement.countDocuments({ ...residenceFilter, status: AnnouncementStatus.SCHEDULED }),
        Announcement.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
          {
            $match: {
              ...residenceFilter,
              ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
              status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED,
              publishedAt: { $gte: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 5, 1), $lte: now },
            },
          },
          { $group: { _id: { $dateToString: { format: "%Y-%m", date: "$publishedAt" } }, count: { $sum: 1 } } },
        ]),
        Incident.aggregate<{
          _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId;
          title: string;
          category: string;
          priority: string;
          status: string;
          createdAt: Date;
          residence: mongoose.Types.ObjectId;
          residenceName: string;
        }>([
          { $match: { ...managedIncidentFilter, status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED }, priority: { $in: ["URGENT", "HIGH"] } } },
          { $addFields: { priorityOrder: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$priority", "URGENT"] }, 2, 1] } } },
          { $sort: { priorityOrder: -1, createdAt: 1 } },
          { $limit: 5 },
          {
            $lookup: {
              from: Residence.collection.name,
              localField: "residence",
              foreignField: "_id",
              pipeline: [{ $project: { name: 1 } }],
              as: "residenceDoc",
            },
          },
          { $addFields: { residenceName: { $ifNull: [{ $arrayElemAt: ["$residenceDoc.name", 0] }, ""] } } },
          { $project: { title: 1, category: 1, priority: 1, status: 1, createdAt: 1, residence: 1, residenceName: 1 } },
        ]),
        Announcement.find({
          ...residenceFilter,
          ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
          status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED,
          publishedAt: { $lte: new Date() },
        })
          .sort({ isPinned: -1, publishedAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title category priority audience publishedAt residence")
          .populate<{ residence: { _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId; name: string } }>({ path: "residence", select: "name" })
          .lean(),
        Incident.aggregate<{ _id: string; assigned: number; inProgress: number; resolved: number }>([
          { $match: { ...managedIncidentFilter, assignedTo: { $ne: null } } },
          { $group: {
            _id: "$assignedTo",
            assigned: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED] }, 1, 0] } },
            inProgress: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS] }, 1, 0] } },
            resolved: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", IncidentStatus.RESOLVED] }, 1, 0] } },
          } },
          { $limit: 20 },
        ]),
        Notification.find({ recipient: user.id })
          .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title message type isRead createdAt relatedResource")
          .lean(),
      ]);
      const statusMap = new Map(incidentCounts.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      const usersByRole = new Map(roleCounts.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      let scopedResidentCount = usersByRole.get(Role.RESIDENT) ?? 0;
      let scopedTechnicianCount = usersByRole.get(Role.TECHNICIAN) ?? 0;
      if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
        const [eligibleByResidence, assignedTechnicianIds] = await Promise.all([
          getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence(residenceIds),
          Incident.distinct("assignedTo", {
            residence: { $in: residenceIds },
            assignedTo: { $ne: null },
          }),
        ]);
        scopedResidentCount = [...eligibleByResidence.values()].reduce((sum, ids) => sum + ids.size, 0);
        scopedTechnicianCount = await User.countDocuments({
          _id: { $in: assignedTechnicianIds },
          role: Role.TECHNICIAN,
          isActive: true,
        });
      }
      const workloadUsers = await User.find({
        _id: { $in: workloadRows.map((item) => item._id) },
        isActive: true,
      }).select("_id name").lean();
      const workloadNames = new Map(workloadUsers.map((item) => [String(item._id), item.name]));
      const eligibleResidents = await getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence(
        [...new Set(latestAnnouncements.map((item) => String(item.residence && typeof item.residence === "object" ? item.residence._id : item.residence)))]
      );
      const readsByAnnouncement = await getReadCountsByAnnouncement(
        latestAnnouncements.map((announcement) => ({
          id: String(announcement._id),
          residenceId: String(announcement.residence && typeof announcement.residence === "object"
            ? announcement.residence._id
            : announcement.residence),
        })),
        eligibleResidents
      );
      const announcementOverview = latestAnnouncements.map((announcement) => {
        const residenceId = String(announcement.residence && typeof announcement.residence === "object" ? announcement.residence._id : announcement.residence);
        const eligible = announcement.audience === AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS
          ? null
          : eligibleResidents.get(residenceId)?.size ?? 0;
        const reads = eligible === null
          ? 0
          : Math.min(readsByAnnouncement.get(String(announcement._id)) ?? 0, eligible);
        return {
          id: String(announcement._id),
          title: announcement.title,
          category: announcement.category,
          priority: announcement.priority,
          publishedAt: announcement.publishedAt,
          residence: announcement.residence && typeof announcement.residence === "object" ? announcement.residence.name : "",
          readCount: reads,
          eligibleReadCount: eligible,
          readPercentage: eligible === null ? null : eligible ? Math.round((reads / eligible) * 100) : 0,
        };
      });

      const incidentsByStatus = [
        { status: "REPORTED", label: "Signalé", count: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.REPORTED) || 0, color: "#38bdf8" },
        { status: "ASSIGNED", label: "Assigné", count: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED) || 0, color: "#f59e0b" },
        { status: "IN_PROGRESS", label: "En cours", count: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS) || 0, color: "#6366f1" },
        { status: "RESOLVED", label: "Résolu", count: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) || 0, color: "#10b981" },
      ];
      const announcementTrendCounts = new Map(announcementTrendRows.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      const announcementByMonth = months.map((period) => ({
        month: new Date(`${period}-01T00:00:00.000Z`).toLocaleDateString("fr-FR", { month: "short" }),
        period,
        count: announcementTrendCounts.get(period) ?? 0,
      }));

      const technicianWorkload = workloadRows.map((item) => ({
        technicianId: String(item._id),
        name: workloadNames.get(String(item._id)) ?? "Technicien",
        assigned: item.assigned,
        inProgress: item.inProgress,
        resolved: item.resolved,
        currentWorkload: item.assigned + item.inProgress,
      })).filter((item) => item.name);

      const overview = {
        residences: residenceCount,
        users: user.role === Role.ADMIN
          ? [...usersByRole.values()].reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0)
          : scopedResidentCount + scopedTechnicianCount + (user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? 1 : 0),
        residents: scopedResidentCount,
        technicians: scopedTechnicianCount,
        incidents: [...statusMap.values()].reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0),
        reported: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.REPORTED) ?? 0,
        assigned: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED) ?? 0,
        inProgress: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS) ?? 0,
        resolved: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) ?? 0,
        urgent: await Incident.countDocuments({ ...managedIncidentFilter, status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED }, priority: "URGENT" }),
        rejectedResolutions: await Incident.countDocuments({
          ...managedIncidentFilter,
          status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED },
          resolutionRejectedAt: { $exists: true },
        }),
        publishedAnnouncements: publishedAnnouncementCount,
        scheduledAnnouncements: scheduledAnnouncementCount,
        urgentIncidents: urgentIncidents.map((item) => ({
          id: String(item._id),
          title: item.title,
          category: item.category,
          priority: item.priority,
          status: item.status,
          createdAt: item.createdAt,
          residence: item.residenceName,
        })),
        recentAnnouncements: announcementOverview,
        technicianWorkload,
        unreadNotifications: await Notification.countDocuments({ recipient: user.id, isRead: false }),
      };

      return json({
        role: user.role,
        kpi: {
          period: currentMonth,
          collectionRate,
          treasury,
          openIncidents,
          unpaidAmount,
          totalApartments: aptIds.length,
        },
        charts: {
          financialByMonth,
          incidentsByStatus,
          announcementByMonth,
        },
        overview,
        latestNotifications,
      });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. RESIDENT
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const aptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      const resIds = await getResidentResidenceIds(user.id);
      await publishDueAnnouncements(resIds);

      // Ce que je dois
      const unpaidChargeFilter = {
        apartment: { $in: aptIds },
        status: { $in: [ChargeStatus.PENDING, ChargeStatus.PARTIAL, ChargeStatus.OVERDUE] },
      };
      const [unpaidCharges, unpaidChargeSummary] = await Promise.all([
        Charge.find(unpaidChargeFilter)
          .populate("apartment", "number floor")
          .sort({ dueDate: 1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("period dueDate amount paidAmount status apartment")
          .lean(),
        Charge.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
          { $match: unpaidChargeFilter },
          { $addFields: { remainingAmount: { $subtract: [{ $ifNull: ["$amount", 0] }, { $ifNull: ["$paidAmount", 0] }] } } },
          { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $gt: ["$remainingAmount", 0] }, "$remainingAmount", 0] } } } },
        ]),
      ]);
      const totalDue = Math.round((unpaidChargeSummary[0]?.total ?? 0) * 100) / 100;


      // Dernières annonces
      const announcementFilter = {
        residence: { $in: resIds },
        ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
        audience: { $in: [AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL] },
      };
      const [announcements, incidents, incidentCounts, notifications, apartments, unreadNotificationCount] = await Promise.all([
        Announcement.find(announcementFilter)
          .sort({ isPinned: -1, priority: -1, publishedAt: -1 })
          .limit(6)
          .select("title content category priority isPinned publishedAt residence")
          .lean(),
        Incident.find({ reportedBy: user.id })
          .sort({ createdAt: -1, reportedAt: -1 })
          .limit(6)
          .select("title category priority status reportedAt createdAt updatedAt resolutionSubmittedAt")
          .lean(),
        Incident.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
          { $match: { reportedBy: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(user.id) } },
          { $group: { _id: "$status", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
        ]),
        Notification.find({ recipient: user.id })
          .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title message type isRead createdAt relatedResource")
          .lean(),
        Apartment.find({ _id: { $in: aptIds } })
          .select("number floor residence")
          .populate<{ residence: { _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId; name: string; city: string } }>({ path: "residence", select: "name city" })
          .lean(),
        Notification.countDocuments({ recipient: user.id, isRead: false }),
      ]);
      const announcementIds = announcements.map((item) => item._id);
      const readAnnouncementIds = new Set((await AnnouncementRead.distinct("announcement", {
        resident: user.id,
        announcement: { $in: announcementIds },
      })).map(String));
      const unreadAnnouncementRows = await Announcement.aggregate<{ count: number }>([
        { $match: announcementFilter },
        {
          $lookup: {
            from: AnnouncementRead.collection.name,
            let: { announcementId: "$_id" },
            pipeline: [
              {
                $match: {
                  $expr: {
                    $and: [
                      { $eq: ["$announcement", "$$announcementId"] },
                      { $eq: ["$resident", new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(user.id)] },
                    ],
                  },
                },
              },
              { $limit: 1 },
              { $project: { _id: 1 } },
            ],
            as: "readRecord",
          },
        },
        { $match: { readRecord: { $size: 0 } } },
        { $count: "count" },
      ]);
      const unreadAnnouncements = unreadAnnouncementRows[0]?.count ?? 0;
      const countByStatus = new Map(incidentCounts.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      const totalIncidents = [...countByStatus.values()].reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
      const openIncidents = totalIncidents - (countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) ?? 0);
      const residenceDetails = [...new Map(apartments.flatMap((apartment) => {
        if (!apartment.residence || typeof apartment.residence !== "object") return [];
        return [[String(apartment.residence._id), {
          id: String(apartment.residence._id),
          name: apartment.residence.name,
          city: apartment.residence.city,
        }] as const];
      })).values()];

      return json({
        role: user.role,
        overview: {
          total: totalIncidents,
          reported: countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.REPORTED) ?? 0,
          assigned: countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED) ?? 0,
          inProgress: countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS) ?? 0,
          resolved: countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) ?? 0,
          urgent: await Incident.countDocuments({ reportedBy: user.id, status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED }, priority: "URGENT" }),
          open: openIncidents,
          unreadAnnouncements,
          unreadNotifications: unreadNotificationCount,
        },
        residences: residenceDetails,
        whatIOwe: {
          totalDue,
          unpaidCharges: unpaidCharges.map((charge) => ({
            ...charge,
            remaining: Math.max(0, charge.amount - (charge.paidAmount ?? 0)),
          })),
        },
        latestAnnouncements: announcements.map((announcement) => ({
          ...announcement,
          _id: String(announcement._id),
          isRead: readAnnouncementIds.has(String(announcement._id)),
        })),
        latestNotifications: notifications,
        myIncidents: {
          items: incidents.map((incident) => ({
            ...incident,
            _id: String(incident._id),
            latestUpdate: incident.updatedAt ?? incident.createdAt ?? incident.reportedAt,
          })),
          total: totalIncidents,
          open: openIncidents,
        },
      });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. TECHNICIAN
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    if (user.role === Role.TECHNICIAN) {
      const assignedFilter = { assignedTo: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(user.id) };
      const technicianResidenceIds = await getTechnicianResidenceIds(user.id);
      await publishDueAnnouncements(technicianResidenceIds);
      const announcementFilter = {
        residence: { $in: technicianResidenceIds },
        ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
        audience: { $in: [AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL] },
      };
      const [incidentCounts, pendingInterventions, resolvedInterventions, latestAnnouncements, notifications, unreadNotificationCount] = await Promise.all([
        Incident.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
          { $match: assignedFilter },
          { $group: { _id: "$status", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
        ]),
        Incident.aggregate([
          { $match: { ...assignedFilter, status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED } } },
          {
            $addFields: {
              priorityOrder: {
                $switch: {
                  branches: [
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "URGENT"] }, then: 4 },
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "HIGH"] }, then: 3 },
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "MEDIUM"] }, then: 2 },
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "LOW"] }, then: 1 },
                  ],
                  default: 0,
                },
              },
            },
          },
          { $sort: { priorityOrder: -1, createdAt: 1 } },
          { $limit: 8 },
          { $lookup: { from: Residence.collection.name, localField: "residence", foreignField: "_id", as: "residenceDoc" } },
          { $unwind: { path: "$residenceDoc", preserveNullAndEmptyArrays: true } },
          { $lookup: { from: Apartment.collection.name, localField: "apartment", foreignField: "_id", as: "apartmentDoc" } },
          { $unwind: { path: "$apartmentDoc", preserveNullAndEmptyArrays: true } },
          {
            $addFields: {
                residence: {
                  $cond: [
                    { $ifNull: ["$residenceDoc._id", false] },
                    { name: "$residenceDoc.name", city: "$residenceDoc.city" },
                    null,
                  ],
                },
                apartment: {
                  $cond: [
                    { $ifNull: ["$apartmentDoc._id", false] },
                    { number: "$apartmentDoc.number", floor: "$apartmentDoc.floor" },
                    null,
                  ],
                },
              },
          },
          { $project: { priorityOrder: 0, residenceDoc: 0, apartmentDoc: 0 } },
        ]),
        Incident.find({ ...assignedFilter, status: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED })
          .sort({ resolvedAt: -1, updatedAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title category priority status resolvedAt resolutionDescription")
          .populate({ path: "residence", select: "name city" })
          .lean(),
        Announcement.find(announcementFilter)
          .sort({ isPinned: -1, publishedAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title category priority isPinned publishedAt residence")
          .populate({ path: "residence", select: "name city" })
          .lean(),
        Notification.find({ recipient: user.id })
          .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title message type isRead createdAt relatedResource")
          .lean(),
        Notification.countDocuments({ recipient: user.id, isRead: false }),
      ]);
      const countByStatus = new Map(incidentCounts.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      const assignedCount = countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED) ?? 0;
      const inProgressCount = countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS) ?? 0;
      const resolvedCount = countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) ?? 0;
      const totalCount = [...countByStatus.values()].reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
      const urgentCount = await Incident.countDocuments({
        ...assignedFilter,
        status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED },
        priority: "URGENT",
      });
      const average = await Incident.aggregate<{ averageHours: number }>([
        { $match: { ...assignedFilter, status: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED, resolvedAt: { $ne: null } } },
        { $group: { _id: null, averageHours: { $avg: { $divide: [{ $subtract: ["$resolvedAt", "$createdAt"] }, 3_600_000] } } } },
      ]);

      return json({
        role: user.role,
        overview: {
          total: totalCount,
          assigned: assignedCount,
          inProgress: inProgressCount,
          resolved: resolvedCount,
          urgent: urgentCount,
          averageResolutionHours: Math.round((average[0]?.averageHours ?? 0) * 10) / 10,
          awaitingReview: await Incident.countDocuments({
            ...assignedFilter,
            resolutionSubmittedAt: { $exists: true },
            resolutionConfirmedAt: { $exists: false },
            resolutionRejectedAt: { $exists: false },
          }),
          unreadNotifications: unreadNotificationCount,
        },
        myInterventions: {
          pending: pendingInterventions,
          recentResolved: resolvedInterventions,
          counts: {
            assigned: assignedCount,
            inProgress: inProgressCount,
            resolved: resolvedCount,
            urgent: urgentCount,
            total: totalCount,
          },
        },
        latestAnnouncements,
        latestNotifications: notifications,
      });
    }

    return json({ role: user.role, message: "Aucune donnée spécifique pour ce rôle" });
  },
  { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT, Role.TECHNICIAN] }
);
````

### `app/api/documents/upload/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { writeFile, mkdir } from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";
import { HttpError, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5 Mo
const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = new Set([
  "application/pdf",
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
]);

const EXTENSIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  "application/pdf": ".pdf",
  "image/jpeg": ".jpg",
  "image/png": ".png",
  "image/webp": ".webp",
};

/**
 * POST /api/documents/upload
 * Téléversement simple d'un fichier (PDF ou image, max 5 Mo).
 * Stocké dans public/uploads/ avec validation de type et de taille côté serveur.
 */
export const POST = withAuth(
  async (req: NextRequest, _user: AuthUser) => {
    const contentType = req.headers.get("content-type") || "";

    let buffer: Buffer;
    let mimeType: string;
    let originalName = "document";

    if (contentType.includes("multipart/form-data")) {
      const formData = await req.formData();
      const file = formData.get("file");

      if (!file || typeof file === "string") {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Fichier manquant dans le champ 'file'");
      }

      const blob = file as File;
      mimeType = blob.type || "application/octet-stream";
      originalName = blob.name || "document";

      if (blob.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Le fichier dépasse la taille maximale autorisée (5 Mo)");
      }

      const arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
      buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);
    } else if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const base64Data = body.base64 || body.file;
      mimeType = body.mimeType || "";
      originalName = body.filename || "document";

      if (!base64Data || typeof base64Data !== "string") {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Contenu base64 manquant");
      }

      // Extraction du data URL si présent : data:image/png;base64,xxxx
      const match = base64Data.match(/^data:([^;]+);base64,(.+)$/);
      let rawBase64 = base64Data;
      if (match) {
        mimeType = mimeType || match[1];
        rawBase64 = match[2];
      }

      buffer = Buffer.from(rawBase64, "base64");
      if (buffer.length > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Le fichier dépasse la taille maximale autorisée (5 Mo)");
      }
    } else {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Format de requête non supporté (attendu: multipart/form-data ou JSON)");
    }

    if (!ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.has(mimeType)) {
      throw new HttpError(
        400,
        `Type de fichier non autorisé (${mimeType}). Formats acceptés : PDF, JPEG, PNG, WEBP.`
      );
    }

    // Répertoire cible public/uploads
    const uploadsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads");
    await mkdir(uploadsDir, { recursive: true });

    const ext = EXTENSIONS[mimeType] || path.extname(originalName) || ".bin";
    const filename = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}${ext}`;
    const filePath = path.join(uploadsDir, filename);

    await writeFile(filePath, buffer);

    const fileUrl = `/uploads/${filename}`;

    return json(
      {
        fileUrl,
        filename: originalName,
        size: buffer.length,
        mimeType,
      },
      201
    );
  },
  { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC] }
);
````

### `app/api/incidents/[id]/ai-verify/route.ts`

````ts
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { isAiEnabled, type ImagePart } from "@/lib/ai/gemini";
import { verifyResolution } from "@/lib/ai/verifyResolution";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { requireIncidentAccess } from "@/lib/incidents/access";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

type RouteContext = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> | { id: string } };
const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const DATA_IMAGE_PATTERN = /^data:(image\/(?:jpeg|png|webp));base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2})$/;
const UPLOAD_IMAGE_PATTERN = /^\/uploads\/([\w.-]+)$/;

async function loadImageAsBase64(urlOrPath: string): Promise<ImagePart> {
  const dataUrlMatch = DATA_IMAGE_PATTERN.exec(urlOrPath);
  if (dataUrlMatch) {
    const data = dataUrlMatch[2];
    const buffer = Buffer.from(data, "base64");
    if (buffer.length > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) throw new HttpError(400, "Image trop volumineuse");
    return { mimeType: dataUrlMatch[1], data: buffer.toString("base64") };
  }

  const uploadMatch = UPLOAD_IMAGE_PATTERN.exec(urlOrPath);
  if (!uploadMatch) throw new HttpError(400, "Format de photo non pris en charge");

  const uploadsDirectory = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads");
  const filePath = path.resolve(uploadsDirectory, uploadMatch[1]);
  if (!filePath.startsWith(`${uploadsDirectory}${path.sep}`)) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Chemin de photo invalide");
  }

  const buffer = await readFile(filePath);
  if (buffer.length > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) throw new HttpError(400, "Image trop volumineuse");
  const extension = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
  const mimeType = extension === ".jpg" || extension === ".jpeg"
    ? "image/jpeg"
    : extension === ".png"
    ? "image/png"
    : extension === ".webp"
    ? "image/webp"
    : null;
  if (!mimeType) throw new HttpError(400, "Format de photo non pris en charge");
  return { mimeType, data: buffer.toString("base64") };
}

async function handleVerification(
  _req: NextRequest,
  user: AuthUser,
  context?: unknown
) {
  const params = await Promise.resolve((context as RouteContext | undefined)?.params);
  const id = params?.id;
  if (!isValidObjectId(id)) throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant d'incident invalide");

  const incident = await requireIncidentAccess(user, id);
  if (
    user.role !== Role.ADMIN
    && user.role !== Role.SYNDIC
    && !(user.role === Role.RESIDENT && incident.reportedBy?.toString() === user.id)
  ) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
  }
  if (!incident.resolutionPhotos?.length) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Aucune photo de résolution à vérifier");
  }
  if (!isAiEnabled()) {
    throw new HttpError(503, "Assistance IA non configurée");
  }
  if (!process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY) {
    throw new HttpError(503, "La vérification des photos nécessite une clé Gemini");
  }

  const before = await Promise.all((incident.photos ?? []).slice(0, 3).map(loadImageAsBase64));
  const after = await Promise.all(incident.resolutionPhotos.slice(0, 3).map(loadImageAsBase64));
  let result;
  try {
    result = await verifyResolution({
      problemDescription: incident.description,
      technicianNote: incident.resolutionDescription,
      before,
      after,
    });
  } catch {
    throw new HttpError(502, "La vérification IA est indisponible pour le moment");
  }
  const checkedAt = new Date();
  incident.aiResolutionCheck = { ...result, checkedAt };
  await incident.save();

  return json({ data: { ...result, checkedAt } });
}

export const POST = withAuth(handleVerification, {
  roles: [Role.RESIDENT, Role.SYNDIC, Role.ADMIN],
});
````

### `app/api/incidents/[id]/assign/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json, parseBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, getSyndicResidenceIds, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import { incidentAssignSchema } from "@/lib/validations/incident";
import { Role, IncidentStatus } from "@/types/enums";
import { canTransition } from "@/lib/incidents/workflow";
import { recordIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/incidents/recordHistory";
import { notifyIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/notifications/events";

interface RouteParams {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }> | { id: string };
}

/**
 * PATCH /api/incidents/[id]/assign
 * Assigne un incident à un technicien.
 * Rôles autorisés : ADMIN, SYNDIC
 * Règle de transition : si l'incident est en REPORTED, passage automatique à ASSIGNED.
 */
export const PATCH = withAuth(
  async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: unknown) => {
    const rawParams = await Promise.resolve((context as RouteParams)?.params);
    const id = rawParams?.id;
    if (!isValidObjectId(id)) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant d'incident invalide");
    }

    const data = await parseBody(req, incidentAssignSchema);
    if (!isValidObjectId(data.assignedTo)) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant de technicien invalide");
    }

    const incident = await Incident.findById(id);
    if (!incident) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Incident introuvable");
    }

    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!syndicResidences.includes(incident.residence.toString())) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas la résidence de cet incident");
      }
    }

    const technician = await User.findById(data.assignedTo).lean();
    if (!technician) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Technicien introuvable");
    }
    if (technician.role !== Role.TECHNICIAN) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "L'utilisateur assigné doit posséder le rôle TECHNICIAN");
    }

    const previousAssignedTo = incident.assignedTo?.toString();
    const previousStatus = incident.status;

    // Si statut REPORTED -> transition automatique vers ASSIGNED
    if (incident.status === IncidentStatus.REPORTED) {
      if (!canTransition(IncidentStatus.REPORTED, IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED)) {
        throw new HttpError(409, `Transition invalide depuis ${incident.status} vers ASSIGNED`);
      }
      incident.status = IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED;
    }

    incident.assignedTo = technician._id;
    await incident.save();

    if (previousAssignedTo !== technician._id.toString()) {
      const previousTechnician = previousAssignedTo
        ? await User.findById(previousAssignedTo).select("name").lean()
        : null;
      const history = await recordIncidentHistory({
        incidentId: incident._id,
        actorId: user.id,
        action: "ASSIGNED",
        description: `Technicien assigné : ${technician.name}`,
        oldValue: previousTechnician?.name,
        newValue: technician.name,
      });
      await notifyIncidentHistory(String(history._id), String(incident._id), "ASSIGNED", user.id);
    }
    if (previousStatus !== incident.status) {
      const history = await recordIncidentHistory({
        incidentId: incident._id,
        actorId: user.id,
        action: "STATUS_CHANGED",
        description: `Statut modifié : ${previousStatus} → ${incident.status}`,
        oldValue: previousStatus,
        newValue: incident.status,
      });
      await notifyIncidentHistory(String(history._id), String(incident._id), "STATUS_CHANGED", user.id);
    }

    await incident.populate([
      { path: "residence", select: "name city" },
      { path: "apartment", select: "number floor" },
      { path: "reportedBy", select: "name" },
      { path: "assignedTo", select: "name" },
    ]);

    return json(incident.toObject ? incident.toObject() : incident, 200);
  },
  { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC] }
);
````

### `app/api/incidents/[id]/comments/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json, parseBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { requireIncidentAccess } from "@/lib/incidents/access";
import { recordIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/incidents/recordHistory";
import { IncidentComment } from "@/models/IncidentComment";
import { incidentCommentSchema } from "@/lib/validations/incident";
import { notifyIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/notifications/events";

interface RouteParams {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }> | { id: string };
}

async function getIncidentId(context?: unknown) {
  const params = await Promise.resolve((context as RouteParams | undefined)?.params);
  if (!isValidObjectId(params?.id)) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant d'incident invalide");
  }
  return params.id;
}

export const GET = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: unknown) => {
  const id = await getIncidentId(context);
  await requireIncidentAccess(user, id);

  const page = Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("page") || "1", 10) || 1);
  const limit = Math.min(50, Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("limit") || "25", 10) || 25));
  const filter = { incident: id };
  const [data, total] = await Promise.all([
    IncidentComment.find(filter)
      .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
      .skip((page - 1) * limit)
      .limit(limit)
      .populate({ path: "author", select: "name role" })
      .lean(),
    IncidentComment.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  return json({ data, meta: { page, limit, total } });
});

export const POST = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: unknown) => {
  const id = await getIncidentId(context);
  await requireIncidentAccess(user, id);
  const data = await parseBody(req, incidentCommentSchema);

  const comment = await IncidentComment.create({
    incident: id,
    author: user.id,
    content: data.content,
    attachments: data.attachments,
  });
  const history = await recordIncidentHistory({
    incidentId: id,
    actorId: user.id,
    action: "COMMENT_ADDED",
    description: "Commentaire ajouté",
  });
  await notifyIncidentHistory(String(history._id), id, "COMMENT_ADDED", user.id);
  await comment.populate({ path: "author", select: "name role" });

  return json(comment.toObject(), 201);
});
````

### `app/api/incidents/[id]/duplicates/route.ts`

````ts
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json, parseBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { recordIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/incidents/recordHistory";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { z } from "zod";

type RouteContext = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };
const reviewSchema = z.object({
  targetIncidentId: z.string().regex(/^[a-f\d]{24}$/i),
  action: z.enum(["LINK", "DISMISS"]),
});

export const POST = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: RouteContext) => {
  if (user.role !== Role.ADMIN && user.role !== Role.SYNDIC) throw new HttpError(403, "Seuls ADMIN et SYNDIC peuvent traiter les doublons potentiels");
  const { id = "" } = await (context?.params ?? Promise.resolve({ id: "" }));
  if (!isValidObjectId(id)) throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant invalide");
  const input = await parseBody(req, reviewSchema);
  if (id === input.targetIncidentId) throw new HttpError(400, "Un incident ne peut pas être lié à lui-même");

  const [source, target] = await Promise.all([
    Incident.findById(id).select("residence title relatedIncidents dismissedDuplicates").lean(),
    Incident.findById(input.targetIncidentId).select("residence title relatedIncidents dismissedDuplicates").lean(),
  ]);
  if (!source || !target || String(source.residence) !== String(target.residence)) {
    throw new HttpError(404, "Incident introuvable");
  }
  const residenceIds = user.role === Role.ADMIN ? null : await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
  if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC && !residenceIds?.includes(String(source.residence))) {
    throw new HttpError(404, "Incident introuvable");
  }

  const sourceId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id);
  const targetId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(input.targetIncidentId);
  if (input.action === "LINK") {
    await Incident.bulkWrite([
      { updateOne: { filter: { _id: sourceId }, update: { $addToSet: { relatedIncidents: targetId }, $pull: { dismissedDuplicates: targetId } } } },
      { updateOne: { filter: { _id: targetId }, update: { $addToSet: { relatedIncidents: sourceId }, $pull: { dismissedDuplicates: sourceId } } } },
    ]);
    await recordIncidentHistory({
      incidentId: sourceId,
      actorId: user.id,
      action: "UPDATED",
      description: `Incident lié à ${target.title.slice(0, 180)} après vérification humaine.`,
    });
    await recordIncidentHistory({
      incidentId: targetId,
      actorId: user.id,
      action: "UPDATED",
      description: `Incident lié à ${source.title.slice(0, 180)} après vérification humaine.`,
    });
    return json({ success: true, action: input.action, relatedIncidentId: input.targetIncidentId });
  }

  await Incident.updateOne(
    { _id: sourceId },
    { $addToSet: { dismissedDuplicates: targetId } }
  );
  await recordIncidentHistory({
    incidentId: sourceId,
    actorId: user.id,
    action: "UPDATED",
    description: `Correspondance potentielle avec ${target.title.slice(0, 180)} écartée après vérification humaine.`,
  });
  return json({ success: true, action: input.action, dismissedIncidentId: input.targetIncidentId });
});
````

### `app/api/incidents/[id]/resolution/confirm/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { requireIncidentAccess } from "@/lib/incidents/access";
import { recordIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/incidents/recordHistory";
import { canTransition } from "@/lib/incidents/workflow";
import { IncidentStatus, Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { notifyIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/notifications/events";

interface RouteParams {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }> | { id: string };
}

export const PATCH = withAuth(async (_req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: unknown) => {
  const params = await Promise.resolve((context as RouteParams | undefined)?.params);
  const id = params?.id;
  if (!isValidObjectId(id)) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant d'incident invalide");
  }

  const incident = await requireIncidentAccess(user, id);
  if (user.role !== Role.RESIDENT || incident.reportedBy?.toString() !== user.id) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Seul le résident à l'origine du signalement peut confirmer la résolution");
  }
  if (!incident.resolutionSubmittedAt || incident.status !== IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
    throw new HttpError(409, "Aucune preuve de résolution en attente de confirmation");
  }
  if (!canTransition(incident.status, IncidentStatus.RESOLVED)) {
    throw new HttpError(409, "Transition de statut invalide");
  }

  const previousStatus = incident.status;
  const now = new Date();
  incident.status = IncidentStatus.RESOLVED;
  incident.resolvedAt = now;
  incident.resolutionConfirmedAt = now;
  incident.resolutionRejectedAt = undefined;
  incident.resolutionFeedback = undefined;
  await incident.save();

  const history = await recordIncidentHistory({
    incidentId: incident._id,
    actorId: user.id,
    action: "RESOLUTION_CONFIRMED",
    description: "Résolution confirmée par le résident",
  });
  await notifyIncidentHistory(String(history._id), String(incident._id), "RESOLUTION_CONFIRMED", user.id);
  await recordIncidentHistory({
    incidentId: incident._id,
    actorId: user.id,
    action: "STATUS_CHANGED",
    description: `Statut modifié : ${previousStatus} → ${IncidentStatus.RESOLVED}`,
    oldValue: previousStatus,
    newValue: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED,
  });

  return json(incident.toObject(), 200);
});
````

### `app/api/incidents/[id]/status/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json, parseBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, getSyndicResidenceIds, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { incidentStatusSchema } from "@/lib/validations/incident";
import { Role, IncidentStatus } from "@/types/enums";
import { canTransition } from "@/lib/incidents/workflow";
import { recordIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/incidents/recordHistory";
import { notifyIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/notifications/events";
import { INCIDENT_WORKFLOW_ROLES } from "@/lib/incidents/access-policy";

interface RouteParams {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }> | { id: string };
}

/**
 * PATCH /api/incidents/[id]/status
 * Met à jour le statut d'un incident selon le workflow strict :
 * REPORTED -> ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED.
 * Rôles autorisés : ADMIN, SYNDIC, TECHNICIAN
 * - TECHNICIAN : uniquement sur les incidents qui lui sont assignés.
 * - resolvedAt posé automatiquement au passage à RESOLVED.
 * - Transitions non conformes = HTTP 409.
 */
export const PATCH = withAuth(
  async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: unknown) => {
    const rawParams = await Promise.resolve((context as RouteParams)?.params);
    const id = rawParams?.id;
    if (!isValidObjectId(id)) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant d'incident invalide");
    }

    const data = await parseBody(req, incidentStatusSchema);
    const targetStatus = data.status;

    const incident = await Incident.findById(id);
    if (!incident) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Incident introuvable");
    }

    // Contrôles spécifiques au technicien
    if (user.role === Role.TECHNICIAN) {
      if (!incident.assignedTo || incident.assignedTo.toString() !== user.id) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Cet incident ne vous est pas assigné");
      }
    }

    // Contrôles spécifiques au syndic
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!syndicResidences.includes(incident.residence.toString())) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas la résidence de cet incident");
      }
    }

    // Respect strict du workflow : REPORTED -> ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED
    if (!canTransition(incident.status, targetStatus)) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        `Transition invalide : passage impossible de "${incident.status}" vers "${targetStatus}". Le cycle strict est REPORTED -> ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED.`
      );
    }

    const previousStatus = incident.status;
    incident.status = targetStatus;

    // Règle métier : resolvedAt posé à RESOLVED
    if (targetStatus === IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) {
      incident.resolvedAt = new Date();
    } else {
      incident.resolvedAt = undefined;
    }

    await incident.save();
    const history = await recordIncidentHistory({
      incidentId: incident._id,
      actorId: user.id,
      action: "STATUS_CHANGED",
      description: `Statut modifié : ${previousStatus} → ${targetStatus}`,
      oldValue: previousStatus,
      newValue: targetStatus,
    });
    await notifyIncidentHistory(String(history._id), String(incident._id), "STATUS_CHANGED", user.id);

    await incident.populate([
      { path: "residence", select: "name city" },
      { path: "apartment", select: "number floor" },
      { path: "reportedBy", select: "name" },
      { path: "assignedTo", select: "name" },
    ]);

    return json(incident.toObject ? incident.toObject() : incident, 200);
  },
  { roles: [...INCIDENT_WORKFLOW_ROLES] }
);
````

### `app/api/incidents/dashboard/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import mongoose, { type PipelineStage } from "mongoose";
import { HttpError, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, getSyndicResidenceIds, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import type { IncidentCategory, IncidentStatus, Priority } from "@/types/enums";
import { incidentDashboardQuerySchema } from "@/lib/validations/incidentDashboard";
import {
  getIncidentStatistics,
  getIncidentsByCategory,
  getIncidentsByStatus,
  getMonthlyIncidentTrends,
  getRecentIncidentActivity,
  getResidenceComparison,
  getTechnicianPerformance,
} from "@/lib/incidents/statistics";

interface DashboardIncidentRow {
  _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId;
  title: string;
  category: IncidentCategory;
  priority: Priority;
  status: IncidentStatus;
  createdAt: Date;
  residence: { _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId; name: string } | null;
}

function parseDate(value: string | undefined, endOfDay = false) {
  if (!value) return undefined;
  const date = new Date(`${value}T${endOfDay ? "23:59:59.999" : "00:00:00.000"}Z`);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) || date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Période de dates invalide");
  }
  return date;
}

export const GET = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
  const query = incidentDashboardQuerySchema.safeParse(
    Object.fromEntries(req.nextUrl.searchParams.entries())
  );
  if (!query.success) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Filtres de tableau de bord invalides", query.error.flatten());
  }

  const now = new Date();
  const to = parseDate(query.data.to, true) ?? now;
  if ((query.data.to || now.toISOString().slice(0, 10)) > now.toISOString().slice(0, 10)) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "La date de fin ne peut pas être dans le futur");
  }
  const from = parseDate(query.data.from)
    ?? new Date(Date.UTC(to.getUTCFullYear(), to.getUTCMonth() - 5, 1));
  if (from > to) throw new HttpError(400, "La date de début doit précéder la date de fin");
  const maxRangeStart = new Date(Date.UTC(
    to.getUTCFullYear() - 5,
    to.getUTCMonth(),
    to.getUTCDate()
  ));
  if (from < maxRangeStart) throw new HttpError(400, "La période ne peut pas dépasser cinq ans");

  const filter: Record<string, unknown> = {
    createdAt: { $gte: from, $lte: to },
  };
  let allowedResidenceIds: string[] | null = null;
  if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
    if (query.data.residence) filter.residence = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(query.data.residence);
  } else if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
    allowedResidenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
    if (query.data.residence && !allowedResidenceIds.includes(query.data.residence)) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas cette résidence");
    }
    filter.residence = query.data.residence
      ? new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(query.data.residence)
      : { $in: allowedResidenceIds.map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id)) };
  } else if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
    filter.reportedBy = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(user.id);
    if (query.data.residence || query.data.technician) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Filtres indisponibles pour ce rôle");
    }
  } else if (user.role === Role.TECHNICIAN) {
    filter.assignedTo = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(user.id);
    if (query.data.residence || query.data.technician) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Filtres indisponibles pour ce rôle");
    }
  } else {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
  }

  if (query.data.technician && (user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC)) {
    filter.assignedTo = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(query.data.technician);
  }

  const recentFilter = { ...filter };
  const priorityFilter = {
    ...filter,
    status: { $ne: "RESOLVED" },
    priority: { $in: ["URGENT", "HIGH"] },
  };
  const [statistics, byStatus, byCategory, monthlyTrends, recentActivity, technicianPerformance, residenceComparison, recentIncidents, priorityIncidents, awaitingConfirmation, residences] =
    await Promise.all([
      getIncidentStatistics(filter),
      getIncidentsByStatus(filter),
      getIncidentsByCategory(filter),
      getMonthlyIncidentTrends(filter, from, to),
      getRecentIncidentActivity(recentFilter, 10),
      user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC
        ? getTechnicianPerformance(filter)
        : Promise.resolve([]),
      user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC
        ? getResidenceComparison(filter)
        : Promise.resolve([]),
      Incident.aggregate<DashboardIncidentRow>([
        { $match: filter as PipelineStage.Match["$match"] },
        { $sort: { createdAt: -1 } },
        { $skip: (query.data.page - 1) * query.data.limit },
        { $limit: query.data.limit },
        {
          $lookup: {
            from: "residences",
            localField: "residence",
            foreignField: "_id",
            pipeline: [{ $project: { name: 1 } }],
            as: "residence",
          },
        },
        {
          $project: {
            _id: 1,
            title: 1,
            category: 1,
            priority: 1,
            status: 1,
            createdAt: { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] },
            residence: { $arrayElemAt: ["$residence", 0] },
          },
        },
      ]),
      Incident.aggregate<DashboardIncidentRow>([
        { $match: priorityFilter as PipelineStage.Match["$match"] },
        {
          $addFields: {
            priorityOrder: {
              $switch: {
                branches: [
                  { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "URGENT"] }, then: 4 },
                  { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "HIGH"] }, then: 3 },
                  { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "MEDIUM"] }, then: 2 },
                ],
                default: 1,
              },
            },
          },
        },
        { $sort: { priorityOrder: -1, createdAt: 1 } },
        { $limit: 8 },
        {
          $lookup: {
            from: "residences",
            localField: "residence",
            foreignField: "_id",
            pipeline: [{ $project: { name: 1 } }],
            as: "residence",
          },
        },
        {
          $project: {
            _id: 1,
            title: 1,
            category: 1,
            priority: 1,
            status: 1,
            createdAt: { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] },
            residence: { $arrayElemAt: ["$residence", 0] },
          },
        },
      ]),
      user.role === Role.RESIDENT
        ? Incident.countDocuments({
            ...filter,
            status: "IN_PROGRESS",
            resolutionSubmittedAt: { $exists: true },
            resolutionConfirmedAt: { $exists: false },
          })
        : Promise.resolve(0),
      user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC
        ? Residence.find(
            user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? { _id: { $in: allowedResidenceIds } } : {}
          ).select("_id name").sort({ name: 1 }).limit(100).lean()
        : Promise.resolve([]),
    ]);

  const [countResult] = await Incident.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
    { $match: filter as PipelineStage.Match["$match"] },
    { $count: "total" },
  ]);
  const incidentCount = countResult?.total ?? 0;

  return json({
    success: true,
    data: {
      role: user.role,
      dateRange: { from: from.toISOString(), to: to.toISOString() },
      statistics,
      awaitingConfirmation,
      byStatus,
      byCategory,
      monthlyTrends,
      recentActivity,
      technicianPerformance,
      residenceComparison,
      residences: residences.map((residence) => ({
        id: residence._id.toString(),
        name: residence.name,
      })),
      recentIncidents: {
        data: recentIncidents.map((incident) => ({
          _id: incident._id.toString(),
          title: incident.title,
          category: incident.category,
          priority: incident.priority,
          status: incident.status,
          createdAt: incident.createdAt.toISOString(),
          residence: incident.residence
            ? { id: incident.residence._id.toString(), name: incident.residence.name }
            : null,
        })),
        meta: {
          page: query.data.page,
          limit: query.data.limit,
          total: incidentCount,
        },
      },
      priorityIncidents: priorityIncidents.map((incident) => ({
        _id: incident._id.toString(),
        title: incident.title,
        category: incident.category,
        priority: incident.priority,
        status: incident.status,
        residence: incident.residence
          ? { id: incident.residence._id.toString(), name: incident.residence.name }
          : null,
      })),
      technicians: technicianPerformance.map((technician) => ({
        id: technician.technicianId,
        name: technician.name,
      })),
    },
  });
});
````

### `app/api/notifications/[id]/read/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Notification } from "@/models/Notification";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

type RouteContext = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> | { id: string } };

export const PATCH = withAuth(async (_req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: RouteContext) => {
  const params = context?.params;
  const { id } = params ? await Promise.resolve(params) : { id: "" };
  if (!isValidObjectId(id)) throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant de notification invalide");
  const notification = await Notification.findOneAndUpdate(
    { _id: id, recipient: user.id, isRead: false },
    { $set: { isRead: true, readAt: new Date() } },
    { new: true }
  )
    .select("type title message relatedResource residence isRead readAt createdAt")
    .lean();
  if (notification) return json(notification);
  const existing = await Notification.findOne({ _id: id, recipient: user.id })
    .select("type title message relatedResource residence isRead readAt createdAt")
    .lean();
  if (!existing) throw new HttpError(404, "Notification introuvable");
  return json(existing);
}, { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT, Role.TECHNICIAN] });
````

### `app/api/notifications/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import { HttpError, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Notification, notificationTypes } from "@/models/Notification";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

const querySchema = z.object({
  page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10000).default(1),
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(20),
  read: z.enum(["true", "false"]).optional(),
  type: z.enum(notificationTypes).optional(),
  q: z.string().trim().max(100).optional(),
});

function safeSearch(value: string) {
  return new RegExp(value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"), "i");
}

export const GET = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
  if (!Object.values(Role).includes(user.role)) throw new HttpError(403, "Rôle non autorisé");
  const parsed = querySchema.safeParse(Object.fromEntries(req.nextUrl.searchParams.entries()));
  if (!parsed.success) throw new HttpError(400, "Filtres de notification invalides");
  const { page, limit, read, type, q } = parsed.data;
  const filter: Record<string, unknown> = { recipient: user.id };
  if (read !== undefined) filter.isRead = read === "true";
  if (type) filter.type = type;
  if (q) filter.$or = [{ title: safeSearch(q) }, { message: safeSearch(q) }];
  const [rows, total, unreadCount] = await Promise.all([
    Notification.find(filter)
      .sort({ createdAt: -1, _id: -1 })
      .skip((page - 1) * limit)
      .limit(limit)
      .select("type title message relatedResource residence isRead readAt createdAt")
      .lean(),
    Notification.countDocuments(filter),
    Notification.countDocuments({ recipient: user.id, isRead: false }),
  ]);
  return json({ data: rows, meta: { page, limit, total }, unreadCount });
}, { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT, Role.TECHNICIAN] });
````

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { getOpenApiDocument } from "@/lib/openapi/generate";

/**
 * GET /api/openapi
 * Renvoie la spécification OpenAPI 3.0 au format JSON.
 * Rôles autorisés : ADMIN, SYNDIC.
 * En production : désactivée sauf si ENABLE_API_DOCS === "true".
 */
export const GET = withAuth(
  async (_req: NextRequest) => {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" && process.env.ENABLE_API_DOCS !== "true") {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Documentation API non disponible");
    }

    const spec = getOpenApiDocument();
    return json(spec);
  },
  { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC] }
);
````

### `app/api/payments/[id]/receipt/route.ts`

````ts
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { PDFDocument, StandardFonts, rgb } from "pdf-lib";
import {
  withAuth,
  getResidentApartmentIds,
  getSyndicResidenceIds,
  type AuthUser,
} from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId } from "@/lib/api";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { Payment } from "@/models/Payment";

const CURRENCY = "€";

// Traduction française des modes de paiement
const METHOD_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  CASH: "Espèces",
  BANK_TRANSFER: "Virement",
  CHEQUE: "Chèque",
  CHECK: "Chèque",
  CARD: "Carte",
};

// Formatage manuel d'un montant sans espace insécable (compatible WinAnsi / pdf-lib)
function formatAmount(value: unknown): string {
  const num = Number(value) || 0;
  return `${num.toFixed(2).replace(".", ",")} ${CURRENCY}`;
}

// Formatage d'une date au format JJ/MM/AAAA
function formatDateFR(dateValue: unknown): string {
  if (!dateValue) return "—";
  const d = new Date(dateValue as string | number | Date);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "-";
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const year = d.getFullYear();
  return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
}

export const GET = withAuth(
  async (
    _req: NextRequest,
    user: AuthUser,
    context?: { params?: Promise<{ id: string }> }
  ) => {
    const resolvedParams = context?.params ? await context.params : undefined;
    const id = resolvedParams?.id;

    if (!isValidObjectId(id)) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant de paiement invalide");
    }

    // Chargement du paiement avec les relations nécessaires au reçu
    const payment = (await Payment.findById(id)
      .populate({
        path: "charge",
        select: "period amount paidAmount apartment",
        populate: {
          path: "apartment",
          select: "number floor residence",
          populate: {
            path: "residence",
            select: "name address city",
          },
        },
      })
      .populate({
        path: "receivedBy",
        select: "name",
      })
      .lean()) as any;

    if (!payment) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Reçu introuvable");
    }

    const charge = payment.charge;
    const apartment = charge?.apartment;
    const residence = apartment?.residence;

    // Contrôle strict du périmètre selon le rôle (renvoie 404 en cas de refus)
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      const resId = residence?._id ? String(residence._id) : String(apartment?.residence || "");
      if (!resId || !syndicResidenceIds.includes(resId)) {
        throw new HttpError(404, "Reçu introuvable");
      }
    } else if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const residentApartmentIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      const aptId = apartment?._id ? String(apartment._id) : String(charge?.apartment || "");
      if (!aptId || !residentApartmentIds.includes(aptId)) {
        throw new HttpError(404, "Reçu introuvable");
      }
    }

    // Extraction des données pour le document PDF
    const receiptNumber = String(payment.receiptNumber || payment._id);
    const paymentDateStr = formatDateFR(payment.paymentDate);
    const residenceName = String(residence?.name || "Copropriété");
    const residenceAddress = [residence?.address, residence?.city]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(", ");
    const apartmentLabel =
      apartment?.number !== undefined
        ? `Lot ${apartment.number}${
            apartment.floor !== undefined && apartment.floor !== null
              ? ` (Étage ${apartment.floor})`
              : ""
          }`
        : "-";
    const periodLabel = String(charge?.period || "-");
    const methodLabel = METHOD_LABELS[String(payment.method)] || String(payment.method || "-");
    const paidThisTime = formatAmount(payment.amount);
    const remainingAmount = Math.max(
      0,
      (Number(charge?.amount) || 0) - (Number(charge?.paidAmount) || 0)
    );
    const remainingLabel = formatAmount(remainingAmount);
    const receiverName = String(payment.receivedBy?.name || "Syndic");

    // Génération du PDF au format A5 (419.5 x 595 pt)
    const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.create();
    const page = pdfDoc.addPage([419.5, 595]);
    const fontRegular = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.Helvetica);
    const fontBold = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.HelveticaBold);

    const { width, height } = page.getSize();
    const margin = 36;
    let y = height - 48;

    // En-tête : Titre et numéro de reçu
    page.drawText("REÇU DE PAIEMENT", {
      x: margin,
      y,
      size: 18,
      font: fontBold,
      color: rgb(0.05, 0.25, 0.45),
    });

    y -= 20;
    page.drawText(`N° de reçu : ${receiptNumber}`, {
      x: margin,
      y,
      size: 10,
      font: fontBold,
      color: rgb(0.3, 0.35, 0.4),
    });

    page.drawText(`Date : ${paymentDateStr}`, {
      x: width - margin - 110,
      y,
      size: 10,
      font: fontRegular,
      color: rgb(0.3, 0.35, 0.4),
    });

    y -= 16;
    page.drawLine({
      start: { x: margin, y },
      end: { x: width - margin, y },
      thickness: 1,
      color: rgb(0.85, 0.88, 0.92),
    });

    // Bloc Résidence & Lot
    y -= 26;
    page.drawText("Copropriété / Résidence", {
      x: margin,
      y,
      size: 9,
      font: fontBold,
      color: rgb(0.45, 0.5, 0.55),
    });

    y -= 15;
    page.drawText(residenceName, {
      x: margin,
      y,
      size: 12,
      font: fontBold,
      color: rgb(0.1, 0.12, 0.15),
    });

    if (residenceAddress) {
      y -= 14;
      page.drawText(residenceAddress, {
        x: margin,
        y,
        size: 10,
        font: fontRegular,
        color: rgb(0.3, 0.35, 0.4),
      });
    }

    y -= 24;
    page.drawText(`Appartement : ${apartmentLabel}`, {
      x: margin,
      y,
      size: 11,
      font: fontBold,
      color: rgb(0.15, 0.18, 0.22),
    });

    // Tableau récapitulatif du règlement
    y -= 24;
    page.drawLine({
      start: { x: margin, y },
      end: { x: width - margin, y },
      thickness: 0.75,
      color: rgb(0.85, 0.88, 0.92),
    });

    const drawRow = (label: string, value: string, boldValue = false) => {
      y -= 24;
      page.drawText(label, {
        x: margin,
        y,
        size: 10,
        font: fontRegular,
        color: rgb(0.3, 0.35, 0.4),
      });
      page.drawText(value, {
        x: width - margin - 140,
        y,
        size: 11,
        font: boldValue ? fontBold : fontRegular,
        color: rgb(0.1, 0.12, 0.15),
      });
    };

    drawRow("Période de la charge :", periodLabel);
    drawRow("Montant réglé :", paidThisTime, true);
    drawRow("Mode de paiement :", methodLabel);
    drawRow("Reste à payer sur la charge :", remainingLabel);

    y -= 16;
    page.drawLine({
      start: { x: margin, y },
      end: { x: width - margin, y },
      thickness: 0.75,
      color: rgb(0.85, 0.88, 0.92),
    });

    // Mention d'encaissement
    y -= 32;
    page.drawText(`Encaissé par : ${receiverName}`, {
      x: margin,
      y,
      size: 10,
      font: fontBold,
      color: rgb(0.2, 0.25, 0.3),
    });

    // Pied de page
    page.drawLine({
      start: { x: margin, y: 48 },
      end: { x: width - margin, y: 48 },
      thickness: 0.5,
      color: rgb(0.85, 0.88, 0.92),
    });

    page.drawText("Document généré par SyndicPro", {
      x: margin,
      y: 32,
      size: 9,
      font: fontRegular,
      color: rgb(0.5, 0.55, 0.6),
    });

    const pdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();

    return new Response(new Uint8Array(pdfBytes), {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/pdf",
        "Content-Disposition": `inline; filename="recu-${receiptNumber}.pdf"`,
        "Cache-Control": "private, no-store",
      },
    });
  },
  {
    roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
  }
);
````

### `app/api/resolutions/[id]/results/route.ts`

````ts
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser, getSyndicResidenceIds, getResidentResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Resolution } from "@/models/Resolution";
import { Meeting } from "@/models/Meeting";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Vote } from "@/models/Vote";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

interface RouteParams {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }> | { id: string };
}

/**
 * GET /api/resolutions/[id]/results
 * Renvoie le dépouillement complet et pondéré d'une résolution :
 * - Totaux pondérés : FOR, AGAINST, ABSTAIN
 * - Adoptée : oui / non (selon requiredMajority)
 * - Quorum atteint : oui / non (selon les tantièmes de l'AG)
 */
export const GET = withAuth(
  async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: unknown) => {
    const rawParams = await Promise.resolve((context as RouteParams)?.params);
    const id = rawParams?.id;
    if (!isValidObjectId(id)) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant de résolution invalide");
    }

    const resolution = await Resolution.findById(id);
    if (!resolution) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Résolution introuvable");
    }

    const meeting = await Meeting.findById(resolution.meeting);
    if (!meeting) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Assemblée générale introuvable");
    }

    // Contrôle d'accès au niveau résidence
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicRes = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!syndicRes.includes(meeting.residence.toString())) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas cette résidence");
      }
    } else if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const resRes = await getResidentResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!resRes.includes(meeting.residence.toString())) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous ne faites pas partie de cette résidence");
      }
    }

    // Calculs pondérés
    const tally = await resolution.countVotes();
    const isAdopted = await resolution.isAdopted();
    const isQuorumReached = await meeting.isQuorumReached();

    const expressedVotes = tally.FOR + tally.AGAINST;
    const totalVotedWeight = tally.FOR + tally.AGAINST + tally.ABSTAIN;
    const approvalRate = expressedVotes > 0 ? (tally.FOR / expressedVotes) * 100 : 0;

    // Récupération des totaux de copropriété pour contexte
    const totalShares = await Apartment.totalShares(meeting.residence);
    const resolutionIds = await Resolution.find({ meeting: meeting._id }).distinct("_id");
    const votingApartmentIds = await Vote.find({ resolution: { $in: resolutionIds } }).distinct("apartment");
    const [presentRow] = await Apartment.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
      { $match: { _id: { $in: votingApartmentIds } } },
      { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: "$shares" } } },
    ]);
    const presentShares = presentRow?.total ?? 0;

    // Nombre de bulletins physiques/enregistrés
    const voteCount = await Vote.countDocuments({ resolution: resolution._id });

    return json(
      {
        resolution: {
          _id: resolution._id,
          title: resolution.title,
          description: resolution.description,
          requiredMajority: resolution.requiredMajority,
          meeting: resolution.meeting,
        },
        tally,
        expressedVotes,
        totalVotedWeight,
        approvalRate: Math.round(approvalRate * 100) / 100,
        isAdopted,
        isQuorumReached,
        quorum: {
          totalShares,
          presentShares,
          percentage: totalShares > 0 ? Math.round((presentShares / totalShares) * 10000) / 100 : 0,
          requiredPercentage: 50,
        },
        voteCount,
      },
      200
    );
  },
  { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT] }
);
````
