### `lib/crud/payments.ts`

````ts
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Payment } from "@/models/Payment";
import { Charge } from "@/models/Charge";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { getResidentApartmentIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { paymentCreateSchema, paymentUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/payment";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

/**
 * Helper qui recalcule et persiste le montant payé et le statut d'une charge
 * à partir de la somme réelle de tous ses paiements.
 */
export async function recalculateCharge(chargeId: string | mongoose.Types.ObjectId): Promise<void> {
  const cId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(String(chargeId));
  const [agg] = await Payment.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
    { $match: { charge: cId } },
    { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: "$amount" } } },
  ]);
  const charge = await Charge.findById(cId);
  if (!charge) return;
  charge.paidAmount = Math.round((agg?.total ?? 0) * 100) / 100;
  charge.updateStatus();
  await charge.save();
}

export const paymentCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Payment,
  createSchema: paymentCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: paymentUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["receiptNumber"],
  defaultSort: { paymentDate: -1, createdAt: -1 },
  populate: [
    {
      path: "charge",
      select: "period amount paidAmount status apartment",
      populate: { path: "apartment", select: "number floor residence", populate: { path: "residence", select: "name" } },
    },
    { path: "receivedBy", select: "name email" },
  ],
  filterFields: ["charge", "method"],
  dateField: "paymentDate",
  exportPopulate: [
    {
      path: "charge",
      select: "period apartment",
      populate: {
        path: "apartment",
        select: "number residence",
        populate: { path: "residence", select: "name" },
      },
    },
    { path: "receivedBy", select: "name" },
  ],
  exportColumns: [
    { key: "receiptNumber", label: "N° reçu" },
    { key: "paymentDate", label: "Date" },
    { key: "amount", label: "Montant" },
    { key: "method", label: "Mode" },
    { key: "charge.period", label: "Période" },
    { key: "charge.apartment.number", label: "Appartement" },
    { key: "charge.apartment.residence.name", label: "Résidence" },
    { key: "receivedBy.name", label: "Encaissé par" },
  ],

  scope: async (user) => {
    // 1. ADMIN : accès global
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    // 2. SYNDIC : paiements des résidences administrées
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      const aptIds = await Apartment.find({ residence: { $in: residenceIds } }).distinct("_id");
      const chargeIds = await Charge.find({ apartment: { $in: aptIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { charge: { $in: chargeIds } };
    }
    // 3. RESIDENT : paiements rattachés à ses propres charges uniquement
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const allowedAptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      const chargeIds = await Charge.find({ apartment: { $in: allowedAptIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { charge: { $in: chargeIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  injectOnCreate: async (user, body) => {
    // Règle de sécurité stricte : receivedBy est TOUJOURS session.user.id
    // Génère receiptNumber de façon unique (REC-AAAAMMJJ-xxxxxx aléatoire)
    const d = new Date();
    const ymd = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, "");
    const rand = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8).toUpperCase();
    const receiptNumber =
      body.receiptNumber && body.receiptNumber.trim().length > 0
        ? body.receiptNumber
        : `REC-${ymd}-${rand}`;

    return {
      receivedBy: user.id,
      receiptNumber,
      syncedAt: new Date(),
    };
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const charge = await Charge.findById(body.charge);
    if (!charge) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Charge introuvable");
    }

    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const apt = await Apartment.findById(charge.apartment).lean();
      if (apt) {
        const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
        if (!residenceIds.includes(String(apt.residence))) {
          throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas la résidence de cette charge");
        }
      }
    }

    // Règle métier : refuse un montant supérieur au reste à payer
    const remaining = Math.round((charge.amount - (charge.paidAmount || 0)) * 100) / 100;
    if (body.amount > remaining + 0.001) {
      throw new HttpError(
        400,
        `Le montant saisi (${body.amount.toFixed(2)} €) dépasse le reste à payer de cette charge (${remaining.toFixed(2)} €)`
      );
    }
  },

  afterUpdate: async (payment) => {
    if (payment?.charge) {
      await recalculateCharge(payment.charge);
    }
  },

  afterDelete: async (payment) => {
    if (payment?.charge) {
      await recalculateCharge(payment.charge);
    }
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/residences.ts`

````ts
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Charge } from "@/models/Charge";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { getResidentResidenceIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { residenceCreateSchema, residenceUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/residence";
import { Role, IncidentStatus } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError, json } from "@/lib/api";

const currentPeriod = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);

export const residenceCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Residence,
  createSchema: residenceCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: residenceUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["name", "city", "address"],
  defaultSort: { name: 1 },
  populate: [{ path: "syndic", select: "name email phone" }],
  filterFields: ["city", "syndic"],

  scope: async (user) => {
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      return { _id: { $in: syndicResidences } };
    }
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const residentResidenceIds = await getResidentResidenceIds(user.id);
      return { _id: { $in: residentResidenceIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  injectOnCreate: async (user, body) => {
    // Si un SYNDIC crée la résidence et ne précise pas d'autre syndic, il s'assigne automatiquement
    return {
      syndic: body.syndic || (user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? user.id : undefined),
    };
  },

  beforeDelete: async (id) => {
    // Règle métier : interdire la suppression d'une résidence qui a des charges
    const aptIds = await Apartment.find({ residence: id }).distinct("_id");
    const hasCharges = await Charge.exists({ apartment: { $in: aptIds } });
    if (hasCharges) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        "Impossible de supprimer cette résidence car des charges y sont rattachées"
      );
    }
    const hasApartments = await Apartment.exists({ residence: id });
    if (hasApartments) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        "Impossible de supprimer cette résidence car des appartements y sont rattachés"
      );
    }
  },

  afterList: async (data, req) => {
    // Compatibilité descendante pour le tableau de bord avec ?withStats=1
    if (req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("withStats") === "1") {
      const period = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("period") ?? currentPeriod();
      const withStats = await Promise.all(
        data.map(async (r: any) => {
          const [collectionRate, balance, openIncidents] = await Promise.all([
            Residence.getCollectionRate(r._id, period),
            Residence.getBalance(r._id),
            Incident.countDocuments({
              residence: r._id,
              status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED },
            }),
          ]);
          return {
            ...r,
            stats: { period, collectionRate, ...balance, openIncidents },
          };
        })
      );
      return json(withStats);
    }
    return undefined;
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/residents.ts`

````ts
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Resident } from "@/models/Resident";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { getResidentApartmentIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { residentCreateSchema, residentUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/resident";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

async function getSyndicApartmentIds(userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(userId);
  const apartmentIds = await Apartment.find({ residence: { $in: residenceIds } }).distinct("_id");
  return apartmentIds.map(String);
}

async function validateResidentAccount(userId?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!userId) return;

  const account = await User.findOne({
    _id: userId,
    role: Role.RESIDENT,
    isActive: { $ne: false },
  })
    .select("_id")
    .lean();

  if (!account) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Le compte associé doit être un compte résident actif");
  }
}

export const residentCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Resident,
  createSchema: residentCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: residentUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["fullName", "email", "phone"],
  defaultSort: { fullName: 1 },
  populate: [
    {
      path: "apartment",
      select: "number floor residence",
      populate: { path: "residence", select: "name" },
    },
    { path: "residence", select: "name" },
    { path: "user", select: "name email" },
  ],
  filterFields: ["apartment", "residence", "type", "isActive"],
  dateField: "moveInDate",
  exportPopulate: [{ path: "apartment", select: "number" }],
  exportColumns: [
    { key: "fullName", label: "Nom" },
    { key: "phone", label: "Téléphone" },
    { key: "email", label: "Email" },
    { key: "type", label: "Type" },
    { key: "apartment.number", label: "Appartement" },
    { key: "residence.name", label: "Résidence" },
    { key: "moveInDate", label: "Emménagement" },
    { key: "isActive", label: "Actif" },
  ],

  scope: async (user) => {
    // 1. ADMIN : accès global
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    // 2. SYNDIC : résidents des appartements gérés
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const aptIds = await getSyndicApartmentIds(user.id);
      const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      return {
        $or: [
          { apartment: { $in: aptIds } },
          { residence: { $in: residenceIds } },
        ],
      };
    }
    // 3. RESIDENT : résidents de son propre appartement
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const allowedAptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      return { apartment: { $in: allowedAptIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    let residenceId = body.residence;
    if (body.apartment) {
      const apartment = await Apartment.findById(body.apartment).select("residence").lean();
      if (!apartment) throw new HttpError(404, "Appartement introuvable");
      residenceId = String(apartment.residence);
      body.residence = residenceId;
    }

    if (!residenceId || !(await Residence.exists({ _id: residenceId }))) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Résidence introuvable");
    }
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!syndicResidences.includes(String(residenceId))) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas cette résidence");
      }
    }
    await validateResidentAccount(body.user);
  },

  beforeUpdate: async (id, user, body) => {
    const managedApartmentIds =
      user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? await getSyndicApartmentIds(user.id) : null;
    const managedResidenceIds =
      user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id) : null;
    const currentResident = await Resident.findById(id)
      .select("apartment residence")
      .lean();

    if (!currentResident) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Ressource introuvable ou modification non autorisée");
    }
    if (
      managedApartmentIds &&
      managedResidenceIds &&
      !(
        (currentResident.apartment &&
          managedApartmentIds.includes(String(currentResident.apartment))) ||
        (currentResident.residence &&
          managedResidenceIds.includes(String(currentResident.residence)))
      )
    ) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Ressource introuvable ou modification non autorisée");
    }

    if (body.residence !== undefined) {
      const residence = await Residence.findById(body.residence).select("_id").lean();
      if (!residence) throw new HttpError(404, "Résidence introuvable");
      if (currentResident.apartment) {
        const apartment = await Apartment.findById(currentResident.apartment)
          .select("residence")
          .lean();
        if (!apartment || String(apartment.residence) !== String(body.residence)) {
          throw new HttpError(400, "La résidence d'un résident déjà associé à un lot ne peut pas être modifiée");
        }
      }
      if (managedResidenceIds && !managedResidenceIds.includes(String(body.residence))) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas cette résidence");
      }
    }

    const requestedUserId = body.user;
    if (requestedUserId !== undefined && typeof requestedUserId !== "string") {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant de compte invalide");
    }
    await validateResidentAccount(requestedUserId);
  },

  afterDelete: async (deletedResident) => {
    await Apartment.updateOne(
      { resident: deletedResident._id },
      { $unset: { resident: 1 } }
    );
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/resolutions.ts`

````ts
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Resolution } from "@/models/Resolution";
import { Meeting } from "@/models/Meeting";
import { Vote } from "@/models/Vote";
import { getResidentResidenceIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { resolutionCreateSchema, resolutionUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/governance";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

export const resolutionCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Resolution,
  createSchema: resolutionCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: resolutionUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["title", "description"],
  defaultSort: { createdAt: -1 },
  populate: [{ path: "meeting", select: "title date status residence" }],
  filterFields: ["meeting"],

  scope: async (user) => {
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) return {};
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const resIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      const meetingIds = await Meeting.find({ residence: { $in: resIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { meeting: { $in: meetingIds } };
    }
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const resIds = await getResidentResidenceIds(user.id);
      const meetingIds = await Meeting.find({ residence: { $in: resIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { meeting: { $in: meetingIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const meeting = await Meeting.findById(body.meeting);
    if (!meeting) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Assemblée générale introuvable");
    }
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicRes = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!syndicRes.includes(meeting.residence.toString())) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas la résidence de cette assemblée");
      }
    }
  },

  beforeDelete: async (id) => {
    const voteCount = await Vote.countDocuments({ resolution: id });
    if (voteCount > 0) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        `Impossible de supprimer une résolution qui a déjà fait l'objet de ${voteCount} vote(s).`
      );
    }
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/votes.ts`

````ts
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Vote } from "@/models/Vote";
import { Resolution } from "@/models/Resolution";
import { Meeting } from "@/models/Meeting";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import {
  getResidentApartmentIds,
  getResidentResidenceIds,
  getSyndicResidenceIds,
} from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { voteCreateSchema, voteUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/governance";
import { MeetingStatus, Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

export const voteCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Vote,
  createSchema: voteCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: voteUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    update: [Role.ADMIN],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN],
  },
  searchFields: ["choice"],
  defaultSort: { votedAt: -1 },
  populate: [
    { path: "resolution", select: "title meeting requiredMajority" },
    { path: "apartment", select: "number shares floor" },
    { path: "voter", select: "name email" },
  ],
  filterFields: ["resolution", "apartment", "choice"],

  scope: async (user) => {
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) return {};
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const resIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      const meetingIds = await Meeting.find({ residence: { $in: resIds } }).distinct("_id");
      const resols = await Resolution.find({ meeting: { $in: meetingIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { resolution: { $in: resols } };
    }
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const myApts = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      return { apartment: { $in: myApts } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const resolution = await Resolution.findById(body.resolution);
    if (!resolution) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Résolution introuvable");
    }

    const meeting = await Meeting.findById(resolution.meeting);
    if (!meeting) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Assemblée générale introuvable");
    }

    // Règle métier : vote refusé si Meeting.status !== OPEN
    if (meeting.status !== MeetingStatus.OPEN) {
      throw new HttpError(
        400,
        `Le vote est refusé : l'assemblée générale n'est pas ouverte au vote (statut actuel : ${meeting.status}).`
      );
    }

    // Règle métier : appartement valide
    const apartment = await Apartment.findById(body.apartment);
    if (!apartment) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Appartement introuvable");
    }

    // L'appartement doit appartenir à la même résidence que l'AG
    if (apartment.residence.toString() !== meeting.residence.toString()) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Le lot n'appartient pas à la résidence de cette assemblée");
    }

    // Contrôle d'accès RESIDENT : ne peut voter qu'avec ses lots
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const myApts = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      if (!myApts.includes(String(body.apartment))) {
        throw new HttpError(
          403,
          "Vous ne pouvez voter qu'au titre des lots dont vous êtes propriétaire ou résident"
        );
      }
    }

    // Règle métier : un seul vote par {resolution, apartment} (409 sinon)
    const existing = await Vote.findOne({
      resolution: body.resolution,
      apartment: body.apartment,
    });
    if (existing) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        `Un vote a déjà été exprimé pour le lot ${apartment.number} sur cette résolution`
      );
    }
  },

  injectOnCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const apartment = await Apartment.findById(body.apartment);
    // Règle métier : weight = tantièmes du lot, voter = session.user.id
    return {
      voter: user.id,
      weight: apartment?.shares ?? 0,
      votedAt: new Date(),
    };
  },
});
````

### `lib/db.ts`

````ts
import mongoose from "mongoose";

const MONGODB_URI = process.env.MONGODB_URI;

if (!MONGODB_URI) {
  throw new Error("MONGODB_URI manquant dans .env.local");
}

type MongooseCache = {
  conn: typeof mongoose | null;
  promise: Promise<typeof mongoose> | null;
};

const globalWithMongoose = global as typeof globalThis & {
  mongooseCache?: MongooseCache;
};

const cached: MongooseCache = (globalWithMongoose.mongooseCache ??= {
  conn: null,
  promise: null,
});

export async function connectDB() {
  if (cached.conn) return cached.conn;

  cached.promise ??= mongoose.connect(MONGODB_URI!, {
    bufferCommands: false,
  });

  cached.conn = await cached.promise;
  return cached.conn;
}
````

### `lib/incidents/access.ts`

````ts
import { getSyndicResidenceIds, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

export async function requireIncidentAccess(user: AuthUser, incidentId: string) {
  const incident = await Incident.findById(incidentId);

  if (!incident) {
    throw new HttpError(404, "Incident introuvable");
  }

  if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
    return incident;
  }

  if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
    const ids = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
    if (!ids.includes(incident.residence.toString())) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
    }
    return incident;
  }

  if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
    if (incident.reportedBy?.toString() !== user.id) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
    }
    return incident;
  }

  if (user.role === Role.TECHNICIAN) {
    if (incident.assignedTo?.toString() !== user.id) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
    }
    return incident;
  }

  throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
}
````

````ts
import { IncidentHistory } from "@/models/IncidentHistory";
import type { Types } from "mongoose";
import type { IncidentHistoryAction } from "@/models/IncidentHistory";

interface RecordHistoryInput {
  incidentId: string | Types.ObjectId;
  actorId: string | Types.ObjectId;
  action: IncidentHistoryAction;
  description: string;
  oldValue?: string;
  newValue?: string;
}

export async function recordIncidentHistory(input: RecordHistoryInput) {
  return IncidentHistory.create({
    incident: input.incidentId,
    actor: input.actorId,
    action: input.action,
    description: input.description,
    oldValue: input.oldValue,
    newValue: input.newValue,
  });
}
````

### `lib/incidents/statistics.ts`

````ts
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { IncidentHistory } from "@/models/IncidentHistory";
import type { PipelineStage } from "mongoose";
import { DEFAULT_INCIDENT_OVERDUE_HOURS } from "./constants";

type IncidentFilter = Record<string, unknown>;

export interface IncidentStatistics {
  total: number;
  reported: number;
  assigned: number;
  inProgress: number;
  resolved: number;
  urgent: number;
  high: number;
  overdue: number;
  averageResolutionHours: number;
  resolutionRate: number;
}

function normalizedFilter(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return filter as Record<string, never>;
}

export async function getIncidentStatistics(
  filter: IncidentFilter,
  overdueHours = DEFAULT_INCIDENT_OVERDUE_HOURS
): Promise<IncidentStatistics> {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - overdueHours * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const [result] = await Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    {
      $addFields: {
        resolutionDuration: {
          $cond: [
            {
              $and: [
                { $eq: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] },
                { $ne: [{ $ifNull: ["$resolvedAt", null] }, null] },
              ],
            },
            {
              $divide: [
                {
                  $subtract: [
                    "$resolvedAt",
                    { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] },
                  ],
                },
                3_600_000,
              ],
            },
            null,
          ],
        },
        incidentCreatedAt: { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] },
      },
    },
    {
      $group: {
        _id: null,
        total: { $sum: 1 },
        reported: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "REPORTED"] }, 1, 0] } },
        assigned: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "ASSIGNED"] }, 1, 0] } },
        inProgress: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "IN_PROGRESS"] }, 1, 0] } },
        resolved: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] }, 1, 0] } },
        urgent: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$priority", "URGENT"] }, 1, 0] } },
        high: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$priority", "HIGH"] }, 1, 0] } },
        overdue: {
          $sum: {
            $cond: [
              {
                $and: [
                  { $ne: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] },
                  { $lt: ["$incidentCreatedAt", cutoff] },
                ],
              },
              1,
              0,
            ],
          },
        },
        averageResolutionHours: { $avg: "$resolutionDuration" },
      },
    },
  ]);
  const stats = result ?? {};
  const total = Number(stats.total) || 0;
  const resolved = Number(stats.resolved) || 0;

  return {
    total,
    reported: Number(stats.reported) || 0,
    assigned: Number(stats.assigned) || 0,
    inProgress: Number(stats.inProgress) || 0,
    resolved,
    urgent: Number(stats.urgent) || 0,
    high: Number(stats.high) || 0,
    overdue: Number(stats.overdue) || 0,
    averageResolutionHours: Math.round(Number(stats.averageResolutionHours) || 0),
    resolutionRate: total ? Math.round((resolved / total) * 100) : 0,
  };
}

export async function getIncidentsByStatus(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $group: { _id: "$status", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
    { $sort: { _id: 1 } },
    { $project: { _id: 0, status: "$_id", count: 1 } },
  ]);
}

export async function getIncidentsByCategory(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $group: { _id: "$category", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
    { $sort: { _id: 1 } },
    { $project: { _id: 0, category: "$_id", count: 1 } },
  ]);
}

export interface MonthlyIncidentTrend {
  month: string;
  reported: number;
  resolved: number;
}

export async function getMonthlyIncidentTrends(
  filter: IncidentFilter,
  from: Date,
  to: Date
): Promise<MonthlyIncidentTrend[]> {
  const scopeFilter = { ...filter };
  delete scopeFilter.createdAt;
  const grouped = await Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(scopeFilter) },
    {
      $facet: {
        reported: [
          {
            $match: {
              $or: [
                { createdAt: { $gte: from, $lte: to } },
                {
                  createdAt: { $exists: false },
                  reportedAt: { $gte: from, $lte: to },
                },
              ],
            },
          },
          {
            $group: {
              _id: {
                $dateToString: {
                  format: "%Y-%m",
                  date: { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] },
                },
              },
              count: { $sum: 1 },
            },
          },
          { $project: { _id: 0, month: "$_id", count: 1 } },
        ],
        resolved: [
          { $match: { status: "RESOLVED", resolvedAt: { $gte: from, $lte: to } } },
          {
            $group: {
              _id: { $dateToString: { format: "%Y-%m", date: "$resolvedAt" } },
              count: { $sum: 1 },
            },
          },
          { $project: { _id: 0, month: "$_id", count: 1 } },
        ],
      },
    },
  ]);
  const monthly = grouped[0] ?? { reported: [], resolved: [] };

  const months: MonthlyIncidentTrend[] = [];
  const cursor = new Date(Date.UTC(from.getUTCFullYear(), from.getUTCMonth(), 1));
  const last = new Date(Date.UTC(to.getUTCFullYear(), to.getUTCMonth(), 1));
  while (cursor <= last) {
    const month = `${cursor.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(cursor.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    const reported = monthly.reported.find((item: { month: string }) => item.month === month);
    const resolved = monthly.resolved.find((item: { month: string }) => item.month === month);
    months.push({
      month,
      reported: Number(reported?.count) || 0,
      resolved: Number(resolved?.count) || 0,
    });
    cursor.setUTCMonth(cursor.getUTCMonth() + 1);
  }
  return months;
}

export async function getTechnicianPerformance(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $match: { assignedTo: { $ne: null } } },
    {
      $group: {
        _id: "$assignedTo",
        assigned: { $sum: 1 },
        completed: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] }, 1, 0] } },
        inProgress: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "IN_PROGRESS"] }, 1, 0] } },
        averageResolutionHours: {
          $avg: {
            $cond: [
              { $and: [{ $eq: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] }, { $ne: ["$resolvedAt", null] }] },
              {
                $divide: [
                  { $subtract: ["$resolvedAt", { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] }] },
                  3_600_000,
                ],
              },
              null,
            ],
          },
        },
      },
    },
    { $lookup: { from: "users", localField: "_id", foreignField: "_id", pipeline: [{ $project: { name: 1, _id: 0 } }], as: "technician" } },
    { $unwind: { path: "$technician", preserveNullAndEmptyArrays: true } },
    {
      $project: {
        _id: 0,
        technicianId: { $toString: "$_id" },
        name: { $ifNull: ["$technician.name", "Technicien"] },
        assigned: 1,
        completed: 1,
        inProgress: 1,
        averageResolutionHours: { $round: [{ $ifNull: ["$averageResolutionHours", 0] }, 0] },
      },
    },
    { $sort: { assigned: -1, name: 1 } },
    { $limit: 50 },
  ]);
}

export async function getResidenceComparison(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $group: { _id: "$residence", incidents: { $sum: 1 } } },
    { $lookup: { from: "residences", localField: "_id", foreignField: "_id", pipeline: [{ $project: { name: 1, _id: 0 } }], as: "residence" } },
    { $unwind: { path: "$residence", preserveNullAndEmptyArrays: true } },
    {
      $project: {
        _id: 0,
        residenceId: { $toString: "$_id" },
        name: { $ifNull: ["$residence.name", "Résidence"] },
        incidents: 1,
      },
    },
    { $sort: { incidents: -1, name: 1 } },
    { $limit: 50 },
  ]);
}

export async function getRecentIncidentActivity(filter: IncidentFilter, limit = 10) {
  const pipeline: PipelineStage[] = [
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $project: { _id: 1, title: 1, category: 1, priority: 1, status: 1, residence: 1 } },
    {
      $lookup: {
        from: IncidentHistory.collection.name,
        localField: "_id",
        foreignField: "incident",
        as: "history",
      },
    },
    { $unwind: "$history" },
    { $sort: { "history.createdAt": -1 } },
    {
      $project: {
        _id: { $toString: "$history._id" },
        incidentId: { $toString: "$_id" },
        title: 1,
        category: 1,
        priority: 1,
        status: 1,
        residenceId: { $toString: "$residence" },
        action: "$history.action",
        description: "$history.description",
        createdAt: "$history.createdAt",
      },
    },
    { $limit: Math.min(50, Math.max(1, limit)) },
  ];
  return Incident.aggregate(pipeline);
}
````

### `lib/incidents/workflow.ts`

````ts
import { IncidentStatus } from "@/types/enums";

/**
 * Workflow strict des incidents (partagé client / serveur, sans dépendance serveur) :
 * REPORTED -> ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED
 */
export const INCIDENT_TRANSITIONS: Record<IncidentStatus, IncidentStatus[]> = {
  [IncidentStatus.REPORTED]: [IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED],
  [IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED]: [IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS],
  [IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS]: [IncidentStatus.RESOLVED],
  [IncidentStatus.RESOLVED]: [],
};

/** Vrai si la transition from -> to est autorisée par le workflow. */
export function canTransition(from: IncidentStatus, to: IncidentStatus): boolean {
  return INCIDENT_TRANSITIONS[from]?.includes(to) ?? false;
}

/** Statut suivant dans le workflow (null si terminal). */
export function nextIncidentStatus(from: IncidentStatus): IncidentStatus | null {
  return INCIDENT_TRANSITIONS[from]?.[0] ?? null;
}
````

### `lib/notifications/events.ts`

````ts
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { IncidentHistory, type IncidentHistoryAction } from "@/models/IncidentHistory";
import { AnnouncementHistory, type AnnouncementHistoryAction } from "@/models/AnnouncementHistory";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import { getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence } from "@/lib/announcements/readStats";
import { deliverNotificationSafely } from "./notification-service";
import { AnnouncementAudience, AnnouncementPriority, Role } from "@/types/enums";
import type { NotificationType } from "@/models/Notification";
import type { IAnnouncement } from "@/models/Announcement";

type IncidentNotificationAction = Extract<
  IncidentHistoryAction,
  | "CREATED"
  | "ASSIGNED"
  | "STATUS_CHANGED"
  | "COMMENT_ADDED"
  | "RESOLUTION_SUBMITTED"
  | "RESOLUTION_CONFIRMED"
  | "RESOLUTION_REJECTED"
>;

const incidentMessages: Record<IncidentNotificationAction, { type: NotificationType; title: string; message: string }> = {
  CREATED: {
    type: "INCIDENT_CREATED",
    title: "Nouvelle réclamation",
    message: "Une nouvelle réclamation a été signalée dans une résidence que vous gérez.",
  },
  ASSIGNED: {
    type: "INCIDENT_ASSIGNED",
    title: "Nouvelle réclamation assignée",
    message: "Une réclamation vous a été assignée.",
  },
  STATUS_CHANGED: {
    type: "INCIDENT_STATUS_CHANGED",
    title: "Mise à jour de réclamation",
    message: "Le statut de votre réclamation a été mis à jour.",
  },
  COMMENT_ADDED: {
    type: "INCIDENT_COMMENTED",
    title: "Nouveau commentaire",
    message: "Un nouveau commentaire a été ajouté à une réclamation à laquelle vous participez.",
  },
  RESOLUTION_SUBMITTED: {
    type: "INCIDENT_RESOLUTION_SUBMITTED",
    title: "Résolution proposée",
    message: "Une proposition de résolution attend votre vérification.",
  },
  RESOLUTION_CONFIRMED: {
    type: "INCIDENT_RESOLUTION_CONFIRMED",
    title: "Résolution confirmée",
    message: "La résolution de la réclamation a été confirmée.",
  },
  RESOLUTION_REJECTED: {
    type: "INCIDENT_RESOLUTION_REJECTED",
    title: "Résolution à revoir",
    message: "La proposition de résolution a été refusée et nécessite un suivi.",
  },
};

async function syndicId(residenceId: string) {
  const residence = await Residence.findById(residenceId).select("syndic").lean();
  return residence?.syndic ? String(residence.syndic) : null;
}

export async function notifyIncidentHistory(
  historyId: string,
  incidentId: string,
  action: IncidentNotificationAction,
  actorId: string
) {
  try {
    const [incident, history] = await Promise.all([
      Incident.findById(incidentId).select("residence reportedBy assignedTo category").lean(),
      IncidentHistory.findById(historyId).select("_id").lean(),
    ]);
    if (!incident || !history) return;

    const residenceId = String(incident.residence);
    const managerId = await syndicId(residenceId);
    const targets = new Set<string>();
    switch (action) {
      case "CREATED":
        if (managerId) targets.add(managerId);
        break;
      case "ASSIGNED":
        if (incident.assignedTo) targets.add(String(incident.assignedTo));
        break;
      case "STATUS_CHANGED":
      case "RESOLUTION_SUBMITTED":
        if (incident.reportedBy) targets.add(String(incident.reportedBy));
        if (action === "RESOLUTION_SUBMITTED" && managerId) targets.add(managerId);
        break;
      case "COMMENT_ADDED":
        if (incident.reportedBy) targets.add(String(incident.reportedBy));
        if (incident.assignedTo) targets.add(String(incident.assignedTo));
        if (managerId) targets.add(managerId);
        break;
      case "RESOLUTION_CONFIRMED":
      case "RESOLUTION_REJECTED":
        if (incident.assignedTo) targets.add(String(incident.assignedTo));
        if (managerId) targets.add(managerId);
        break;
    }
    targets.delete(actorId);
    if (targets.size === 0) return;

    const copy = incidentMessages[action];
    await deliverNotificationSafely([...targets], {
      actorId,
      type: copy.type,
      title: copy.title,
      message: action === "CREATED"
        ? `Une nouvelle réclamation ${incident.category.toLowerCase()} a été signalée dans une résidence que vous gérez.`
        : copy.message,
      resourceType: "INCIDENT",
      resourceId: incidentId,
      residenceId,
      eventKey: `incident-history:${historyId}`,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[notifications] Incident event could not be prepared", {
      historyId,
      errorName: error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown",
    });
  }
}

export async function notifyAnnouncementPublished(
  announcement: Pick<IAnnouncement, "residence" | "audience" | "title" | "priority"> & { _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId | string },
  eventKey: string,
  actorId?: string
) {
  try {
    const residenceId = String(announcement.residence);
    const audience = announcement.audience ?? AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS;
    const priority = announcement.priority ?? AnnouncementPriority.NORMAL;
    const normalizedAnnouncement = { ...announcement, audience, priority };
    await recordAnnouncementActivity(normalizedAnnouncement, "PUBLISHED", eventKey, actorId);
    const recipients = new Set<string>();
    if (
      audience === AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS ||
      audience === AnnouncementAudience.ALL
    ) {
      const residentIds = (await getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence([residenceId])).get(residenceId);
      for (const id of residentIds ?? []) recipients.add(id);
    }
    if (
      audience === AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS ||
      audience === AnnouncementAudience.ALL
    ) {
      const assignedTechnicians = await Incident.distinct("assignedTo", {
        residence: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(residenceId),
        assignedTo: { $ne: null },
      });
      const activeTechnicians = await User.distinct("_id", {
        _id: { $in: assignedTechnicians },
        role: Role.TECHNICIAN,
        isActive: true,
      });
      for (const id of activeTechnicians) recipients.add(String(id));
    }
    if (recipients.size === 0) return;
    await deliverNotificationSafely([...recipients], {
      type: "ANNOUNCEMENT_PUBLISHED",
      title: priority === "URGENT" ? "Annonce urgente" : priority === "HIGH" ? "Annonce importante" : "Nouvelle annonce",
      message: announcement.title,
      resourceType: "ANNOUNCEMENT",
      resourceId: String(announcement._id),
      residenceId,
      eventKey,
      metadata: { priority },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[notifications] Announcement event could not be prepared", {
      eventKey,
      errorName: error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown",
    });
  }
}

export async function recordAnnouncementActivity(
  announcement: Pick<IAnnouncement, "residence" | "audience" | "title" | "priority"> & { _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId | string },
  action: AnnouncementHistoryAction,
  eventKey: string,
  actorId?: string
) {
  try {
    const audience = announcement.audience ?? AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS;
    const priority = announcement.priority ?? AnnouncementPriority.NORMAL;
    await AnnouncementHistory.updateOne(
      { eventKey },
      {
        $setOnInsert: {
          announcement: announcement._id,
          residence: announcement.residence,
          actor: actorId ?? null,
          action,
          title: announcement.title,
          audience,
          priority,
          eventKey,
        },
      },
      { upsert: true }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[activity] Announcement event could not be recorded", {
      eventKey,
      errorName: error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown",
    });
  }
}
````

### `lib/notifications/notification-service.ts`

````ts
import "server-only";
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import { Notification, notificationTypes, type NotificationType, type NotificationResourceType } from "@/models/Notification";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { Announcement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence } from "@/lib/announcements/readStats";
import { AnnouncementAudience, AnnouncementStatus, Role } from "@/types/enums";

export interface NotificationInput {
  recipientId: string;
  actorId?: string | null;
  type: NotificationType;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  resourceType: NotificationResourceType;
  resourceId?: string;
  residenceId?: string;
  eventKey: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, string | number | boolean>;
}

function isObjectId(value: string | null | undefined): value is string {
  return Boolean(value && mongoose.isValidObjectId(value));
}

async function activeRecipients(ids: string[]) {
  const validIds = [...new Set(ids.filter(isObjectId))];
  if (!validIds.length) return [];
  return User.find({
    _id: { $in: validIds },
    isActive: true,
    role: { $in: Object.values(Role) },
  }).select("_id role").lean();
}

async function authorizedRecipients(
  candidates: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof activeRecipients>>,
  notification: Omit<NotificationInput, "recipientId">
) {
  if (candidates.length === 0) return new Set<string>();
  const candidateIds = candidates.map((user) => String(user._id));
  if (notification.resourceType === "SYSTEM") {
    return new Set(candidates.filter((user) => user.role === Role.ADMIN).map((user) => String(user._id)));
  }
  if (!notification.resourceId || !notification.residenceId) return new Set<string>();

  if (notification.resourceType === "INCIDENT") {
    const incident = await Incident.findById(notification.resourceId)
      .select("residence reportedBy assignedTo")
      .lean();
    if (!incident || String(incident.residence) !== notification.residenceId) return new Set<string>();
    const managerIds = await Residence.distinct("syndic", {
      _id: notification.residenceId,
      syndic: { $in: candidateIds },
    });
    const managerSet = new Set(managerIds.map(String));
    const reporterId = incident.reportedBy ? String(incident.reportedBy) : null;
    const assignedTechnicianId = incident.assignedTo ? String(incident.assignedTo) : null;
    return new Set(candidates
      .filter((user) => {
        const id = String(user._id);
        return user.role === Role.ADMIN ||
          (user.role === Role.SYNDIC && managerSet.has(id)) ||
          (user.role === Role.RESIDENT && id === reporterId) ||
          (user.role === Role.TECHNICIAN && id === assignedTechnicianId);
      })
      .map((user) => String(user._id)));
  }

  const announcement = await Announcement.findById(notification.resourceId)
    .select("residence audience status scheduledAt expiresAt")
    .lean();
  const now = new Date();
  if (
    !announcement ||
    String(announcement.residence) !== notification.residenceId ||
    (announcement.status ?? AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED) !== AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED ||
    (announcement.scheduledAt && announcement.scheduledAt > now) ||
    (announcement.expiresAt && announcement.expiresAt <= now)
  ) return new Set<string>();

  const audience = announcement.audience ?? AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS;
  const allowed = new Set<string>();
  if (audience === AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS || audience === AnnouncementAudience.ALL) {
    const residentIds = (await getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence([notification.residenceId]))
      .get(notification.residenceId);
    for (const id of residentIds ?? []) allowed.add(id);
  }
  if (audience === AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS || audience === AnnouncementAudience.ALL) {
    const assigned = await Incident.distinct("assignedTo", {
      residence: notification.residenceId,
      assignedTo: { $ne: null },
    });
    const technicians = await User.distinct("_id", {
      _id: { $in: assigned },
      role: Role.TECHNICIAN,
      isActive: true,
    });
    for (const id of technicians) allowed.add(String(id));
  }
  return new Set(candidates
    .filter((user) => user.role !== Role.ADMIN && user.role !== Role.SYNDIC && allowed.has(String(user._id)))
    .map((user) => String(user._id)));
}

export async function createNotification(input: NotificationInput): Promise<void> {
  const { recipientId, ...notification } = input;
  await notifyUsers([recipientId], notification);
}

export async function notifyUsers(
  recipientIds: string[],
  notification: Omit<NotificationInput, "recipientId">
): Promise<void> {
  if (
    !Array.isArray(recipientIds) ||
    recipientIds.some((id) => !isObjectId(id)) ||
    typeof notification.eventKey !== "string" ||
    !notification.eventKey ||
    notification.eventKey.length > 200 ||
    typeof notification.title !== "string" ||
    notification.title.trim().length === 0 ||
    notification.title.length > 160 ||
    typeof notification.message !== "string" ||
    notification.message.trim().length === 0 ||
    notification.message.length > 500 ||
    !notificationTypes.includes(notification.type) ||
    !["INCIDENT", "ANNOUNCEMENT", "SYSTEM"].includes(notification.resourceType) ||
    (notification.resourceType !== "SYSTEM" && (!notification.resourceId || !notification.residenceId)) ||
    (notification.resourceId !== undefined && !isObjectId(notification.resourceId)) ||
    (notification.residenceId !== undefined && !isObjectId(notification.residenceId)) ||
    (notification.actorId != null && !isObjectId(notification.actorId))
  ) {
    throw new Error("Invalid notification event");
  }

  const candidates = await activeRecipients(recipientIds);
  const recipients = await authorizedRecipients(candidates, notification);
  if (recipients.size === 0) return;
  const resourceId = notification.resourceId
    ? new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(notification.resourceId)
    : null;
  const residenceId = notification.residenceId
    ? new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(notification.residenceId)
    : null;
  const actorId = notification.actorId
    ? new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(notification.actorId)
    : null;

  const documents = [...recipients].map((recipient) => ({
    updateOne: {
      filter: { recipient: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(recipient), eventKey: notification.eventKey },
      update: {
        $setOnInsert: {
          recipient: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(recipient),
          actor: actorId,
          type: notification.type,
          title: notification.title.trim(),
          message: notification.message.trim(),
          relatedResource: { resourceType: notification.resourceType, resourceId },
          residence: residenceId,
          metadata: notification.metadata ?? {},
          eventKey: notification.eventKey,
          isRead: false,
          readAt: null,
        },
      },
      upsert: true,
    },
  }));

  try {
    for (let offset = 0; offset < documents.length; offset += 500) {
      await Notification.bulkWrite(documents.slice(offset, offset + 500), { ordered: false });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[notifications] Failed to deliver notification batch", {
      eventKey: notification.eventKey,
      recipients: recipients.size,
      errorName: error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown",
    });
  }
}

export async function deliverNotificationSafely(
  recipientIds: string[],
  notification: Omit<NotificationInput, "recipientId">
) {
  try {
    await notifyUsers(recipientIds, notification);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[notifications] Failed to prepare notification", {
      eventKey: notification.eventKey,
      errorName: error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown",
    });
  }
}
````

### `lib/offline/apiClient.ts`

````ts
import { getOfflineDB } from "./db";
import type {
  ResidenceDTO,
  ApartmentDTO,
  ChargeDTO,
  IncidentDTO,
  AnnouncementDTO,
  DocumentDTO,
  PaymentDTO,
} from "@/types/api";

interface FetchOptions extends RequestInit {
  entity?: "residence" | "apartment" | "charge" | "incident" | "announcement" | "payment" | "document";
  offlineFallbackData?: unknown;
}

/**
 * Client HTTP : Fonctionnement 100% standard en ligne, avec repli automatique
 * uniquement si la connexion internet est coupée.
 */
export async function fetchWithOffline<T>(url: string, options: FetchOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  const method = (options.method || "GET").toUpperCase();
  const db = getOfflineDB();

  const isActuallyOnline = typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.onLine : true;

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1. REQUÊTES EN LECTURE (GET)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  if (method === "GET") {
    // Si on a du réseau : appel direct au serveur comme un site normal
    if (isActuallyOnline) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(url, options);
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = (await res.json()) as T;
          // Mise en cache asynchrone en arrière-plan sans bloquer
          cacheGetResult(url, data).catch(() => {});
          return data;
        }
        // Si le serveur a répondu (ex: 400 ou 500), on remonte l'erreur sans basculer sur le offline
        const errorText = await res.text();
        throw new Error(`Erreur serveur (${res.status}): ${errorText}`);
      } catch (networkError: unknown) {
        // Seulement si c'est une VRAIE erreur de coupure réseau (ex: Failed to fetch)
        if (
          !navigator.onLine ||
          (networkError instanceof TypeError && networkError.message.includes("fetch"))
        ) {
          console.warn("[ApiClient] Connexion réseau perdue, passage automatique au cache local.");
        } else {
          throw networkError;
        }
      }
    }

    // Réseau coupé : repli transparent sur le cache local Dexie
    const cached = await readFromLocalCache<T>(url);
    if (cached !== null) {
      return cached;
    }

    if (options.offlineFallbackData !== undefined) {
      return options.offlineFallbackData as T;
    }

    throw new Error("Vous êtes hors ligne et cette ressource n'a pas encore été consultée.");
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2. REQUÊTES EN SUPPRESSION (DELETE)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const entityType = options.entity || inferEntityFromUrl(url);
  const targetId = url.split("?")[0].split("/").filter(Boolean).pop();

  if (method === "DELETE") {
    if (isActuallyOnline) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(url, options);
        if (res.ok) {
          const responseData = (await res.json().catch(() => ({ success: true }))) as T;
          if (targetId) {
            removeLocalCacheItem(entityType, targetId).catch(() => {});
          }
          return responseData;
        }
        const errorJson = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errorJson.error || `Erreur serveur (${res.status})`);
      } catch (networkError: unknown) {
        if (!navigator.onLine || (networkError instanceof TypeError && networkError.message.includes("fetch"))) {
          console.warn("[ApiClient] Coupure réseau pendant le DELETE, bascule automatique sur l'Outbox.");
        } else {
          throw networkError;
        }
      }
    }

    // Réseau coupé pour DELETE : enregistrement outbox et retrait du cache local
    const clientId =
      typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID
        ? crypto.randomUUID()
        : `offline-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`;

    const { getOfflineSession } = await import("./db");
    const offlineUser = await getOfflineSession();

    await db.outbox.put({
      id: clientId,
      userId: offlineUser?.id,
      entity: (entityType as any) || "incident",
      method: "DELETE",
      url,
      payload: {},
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: "pending",
      retries: 0,
    });

    if (targetId) {
      await removeLocalCacheItem(entityType, targetId);
    }

    return { success: true } as unknown as T;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3. REQUÊTES EN ÉCRITURE (POST / PATCH / PUT)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const rawBody = options.body ? JSON.parse(options.body as string) : {};

  // Si on est en ligne : envoi direct normal au serveur
  if (isActuallyOnline) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        ...options,
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          ...(options.headers || {}),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(rawBody),
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        const responseData = (await res.json()) as T;
        updateLocalCacheAfterMutation(entityType, responseData, false, method).catch(() => {});
        return responseData;
      }

      // Si le serveur a rejeté la requête métier (ex: validation 400), on retourne l'erreur
      const errorJson = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(errorJson.error || `Erreur serveur (${res.status})`);
    } catch (networkError: unknown) {
      if (
        !navigator.onLine ||
        (networkError instanceof TypeError && networkError.message.includes("fetch"))
      ) {
        console.warn("[ApiClient] Coupure réseau pendant la mutation, bascule automatique sur l'Outbox.");
      } else {
        throw networkError;
      }
    }
  }

  // Réseau coupé : enregistrement automatique dans la file Outbox et réponse optimiste
  const { getOfflineSession } = await import("./db");
  const offlineUser = await getOfflineSession();

  // PATCH hors ligne : met à jour l'élément existant dans Dexie sans créer de faux élément
  if (method === "PATCH") {
    const clientId =
      rawBody.clientId ||
      (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID
        ? crypto.randomUUID()
        : `offline-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`);

    await db.outbox.put({
      id: clientId,
      userId: offlineUser?.id,
      entity: (entityType as any) || "incident",
      method: "PATCH",
      url,
      payload: rawBody,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: "pending",
      retries: 0,
    });

    const updated = await patchLocalCacheItem(entityType, targetId || "", rawBody);
    return updated as unknown as T;
  }

  // POST hors ligne : création optimiste
  const clientId =
    rawBody.clientId ||
    (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID
      ? crypto.randomUUID()
      : `offline-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`);

  const payload = {
    ...rawBody,
    clientId,
  };

  await db.outbox.put({
    id: clientId,
    userId: offlineUser?.id,
    entity: (entityType as any) || "incident",
    method: "POST",
    url,
    payload,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: "pending",
    retries: 0,
  });

  const optimisticResult = createOptimisticResponse(entityType, payload, clientId);
  await updateLocalCacheAfterMutation(entityType, optimisticResult, true, "POST");

  return optimisticResult as unknown as T;
}

function inferEntityFromUrl(url: string): string {
  if (url.includes("/api/incidents")) return "incident";
  if (url.includes("/api/payments")) return "payment";
  if (url.includes("/api/charges")) return "charge";
  if (url.includes("/api/announcements")) return "announcement";
  if (url.includes("/api/residences")) return "residence";
  if (url.includes("/api/apartments")) return "apartment";
  if (url.includes("/api/documents")) return "document";
  return "unknown";
}

async function cacheGetResult(url: string, rawData: unknown) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !rawData) return;
  const db = getOfflineDB();

  // Les réponses API sont { data: [...], meta } ou tableau
  const data =
    typeof rawData === "object" && rawData !== null && "data" in rawData
      ? (rawData as any).data
      : rawData;

  try {
    if (url.includes("/api/residences")) {
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? (data as ResidenceDTO[]) : [data as ResidenceDTO];
      await db.residences.bulkPut(list);
    } else if (url.includes("/api/apartments")) {
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? (data as ApartmentDTO[]) : [data as ApartmentDTO];
      await db.apartments.bulkPut(list);
    } else if (url.includes("/api/charges")) {
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? (data as ChargeDTO[]) : [data as ChargeDTO];
      await db.charges.bulkPut(list);
    } else if (url.includes("/api/incidents")) {
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? (data as IncidentDTO[]) : [data as IncidentDTO];
      await db.incidents.bulkPut(list);
    } else if (url.includes("/api/announcements")) {
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? (data as AnnouncementDTO[]) : [data as AnnouncementDTO];
      await db.announcements.bulkPut(list);
    } else if (url.includes("/api/documents")) {
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? (data as DocumentDTO[]) : [data as DocumentDTO];
      await db.documents.bulkPut(list);
    } else if (url.includes("/api/dashboard")) {
      await db.dashboard.put({
        id: "current",
        data: rawData,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignorer silencieusement
  }
}

async function readFromLocalCache<T>(url: string): Promise<T | null> {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const db = getOfflineDB();

  try {
    if (url.includes("/api/dashboard")) {
      const cached = await db.dashboard.get("current");
      return (cached?.data || null) as unknown as T;
    }

    // Gestion ressource unique /api/<entity>/[id]
    const pathNoQuery = url.split("?")[0];
    const matchId = pathNoQuery.match(/\/api\/([a-z]+)\/([a-f0-9]{24}|[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,})$/i);
    if (matchId) {
      const entity = matchId[1];
      const id = matchId[2];
      let item = null;
      if (entity === "residences") item = await db.residences.get(id);
      else if (entity === "apartments") item = await db.apartments.get(id);
      else if (entity === "charges") item = await db.charges.get(id);
      else if (entity === "incidents") item = await db.incidents.get(id);
      else if (entity === "announcements") item = await db.announcements.get(id);
      else if (entity === "documents") item = await db.documents.get(id);
      if (item) return item as unknown as T;
    }

    let items: any[] = [];
    if (url.includes("/api/residences")) {
      items = await db.residences.toArray();
    } else if (url.includes("/api/apartments")) {
      items = await db.apartments.toArray();
    } else if (url.includes("/api/charges")) {
      items = await db.charges.toArray();
    } else if (url.includes("/api/incidents")) {
      items = await db.incidents.reverse().sortBy("reportedAt");
    } else if (url.includes("/api/announcements")) {
      items = await db.announcements.reverse().sortBy("publishedAt");
    } else if (url.includes("/api/documents")) {
      items = await db.documents.reverse().sortBy("uploadedAt");
    }

    if (items.length > 0) {
      return {
        data: items,
        meta: {
          page: 1,
          limit: items.length,
          total: items.length,
        },
      } as unknown as T;
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignorer silencieusement
  }
  return null;
}

function createOptimisticResponse(entity: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>, clientId: string) {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  if (entity === "incident") {
    return {
      _id: clientId,
      clientId,
      residence: payload.residence,
      apartment: payload.apartment,
      title: payload.title,
      description: payload.description,
      category: payload.category,
      photos: payload.photos || [],
      priority: payload.priority || "MEDIUM",
      status: "REPORTED",
      reportedAt: now,
      createdOffline: true,
      pending: true,
    } as IncidentDTO;
  }

  if (entity === "payment") {
    return {
      _id: clientId,
      clientId,
      charge: payload.charge,
      amount: payload.amount,
      paymentDate: now,
      method: payload.method,
      receiptNumber: `OFFLINE-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`,
      createdOffline: true,
    } as PaymentDTO;
  }

  return {
    _id: clientId,
    ...payload,
    createdOffline: true,
  };
}

async function removeLocalCacheItem(entity: string, id: string) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !id) return;
  const db = getOfflineDB();
  try {
    if (entity === "incident") await db.incidents.delete(id);
    else if (entity === "charge") await db.charges.delete(id);
    else if (entity === "residence") await db.residences.delete(id);
    else if (entity === "apartment") await db.apartments.delete(id);
    else if (entity === "announcement") await db.announcements.delete(id);
    else if (entity === "document") await db.documents.delete(id);
  } catch {
    // Ignorer
  }
}

async function patchLocalCacheItem(entity: string, id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !id) return { _id: id, ...patch };
  const db = getOfflineDB();
  try {
    if (entity === "incident") {
      const existing = await db.incidents.get(id);
      if (existing) {
        const merged = { ...existing, ...patch, pending: true };
        await db.incidents.put(merged);
        return merged;
      }
    } else if (entity === "charge") {
      const existing = await db.charges.get(id);
      if (existing) {
        const merged = { ...existing, ...patch };
        await db.charges.put(merged);
        return merged;
      }
    } else if (entity === "residence") {
      const existing = await db.residences.get(id);
      if (existing) {
        const merged = { ...existing, ...patch };
        await db.residences.put(merged);
        return merged;
      }
    } else if (entity === "apartment") {
      const existing = await db.apartments.get(id);
      if (existing) {
        const merged = { ...existing, ...patch };
        await db.apartments.put(merged);
        return merged;
      }
    } else if (entity === "announcement") {
      const existing = await db.announcements.get(id);
      if (existing) {
        const merged = { ...existing, ...patch };
        await db.announcements.put(merged);
        return merged;
      }
    } else if (entity === "document") {
      const existing = await db.documents.get(id);
      if (existing) {
        const merged = { ...existing, ...patch };
        await db.documents.put(merged);
        return merged;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignorer
  }
  return { _id: id, ...patch };
}

async function updateLocalCacheAfterMutation(
  entity: string,
  data: unknown,
  isOptimistic = false,
  _method = "POST"
) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !data) return;
  const db = getOfflineDB();

  try {
    if (entity === "incident") {
      const incident = data as IncidentDTO;
      await db.incidents.put({
        ...incident,
        pending: isOptimistic,
      });
    } else if (entity === "payment") {
      const payment = data as PaymentDTO;
      if (isOptimistic) {
        // En mode optimiste hors ligne : mise à jour temporaire
        const charge = await db.charges.get(payment.charge);
        if (charge) {
          const updatedPaid = (charge.paidAmount || 0) + payment.amount;
          await db.charges.update(charge._id, {
            paidAmount: updatedPaid,
            remaining: Math.max(0, charge.amount - updatedPaid),
            status: updatedPaid >= charge.amount ? "PAID" : "PARTIAL",
          });
        }
      } else {
        // En ligne / synchro : recalcule à partir des données serveur au lieu d'ajouter le montant
        try {
          const chargeRes = await fetch(`/api/charges/${payment.charge}`);
          if (chargeRes.ok) {
            const chargeData = await chargeRes.json();
            const chargeToStore =
              chargeData && typeof chargeData === "object" && "data" in chargeData
                ? chargeData.data
                : chargeData;
            if (chargeToStore && chargeToStore._id) {
              await db.charges.put(chargeToStore);
            }
          }
        } catch {
          // Si échec réseau, on ne sur-ajoute pas
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignorer
  }
}
````

### `lib/offline/db.ts`

````ts
import Dexie, { type Table } from "dexie";
import type {
  ResidenceDTO,
  ApartmentDTO,
  ChargeDTO,
  AnnouncementDTO,
  IncidentDTO,
  DocumentDTO,
} from "@/types/api";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

export interface OfflineSessionProfile {
  id: string; // userId
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
  expiresAt: number; // timestamp ms
}

export interface OutboxItem {
  id: string; // uuid = clientId
  userId?: string; // id de l'utilisateur ayant émis la requête
  entity: "incident" | "payment" | "charge" | "announcement" | "residence" | "apartment" | "document";
  method: "POST" | "PATCH" | "DELETE";
  url: string;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
  createdAt: string;
  status: "pending" | "syncing" | "failed";
  retries: number;
  error?: string;
}

export interface AnnouncementFeedSnapshot {
  key: string;
  data: unknown;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export class SyndicProDatabase extends Dexie {
  residences!: Table<ResidenceDTO, string>;
  apartments!: Table<ApartmentDTO, string>;
  charges!: Table<ChargeDTO, string>;
  announcements!: Table<AnnouncementDTO, string>;
  incidents!: Table<IncidentDTO, string>;
  documents!: Table<DocumentDTO, string>;
  outbox!: Table<OutboxItem, string>;
  session!: Table<OfflineSessionProfile, string>;
  dashboard!: Table<{ id: string; data: unknown; updatedAt: string }, string>;
  announcementFeeds!: Table<AnnouncementFeedSnapshot, string>;

  constructor() {
    super("SyndicProDB");
    this.version(1).stores({
      residences: "_id",
      apartments: "_id, residence",
      charges: "_id, apartment, period, status",
      announcements: "_id, residence, isPinned, publishedAt",
      incidents: "_id, residence, status, clientId, reportedAt",
      documents: "_id, residence, type",
      outbox: "id, status, createdAt, entity",
    });
    this.version(2).stores({
      outbox: "id, status, createdAt, entity, userId",
      session: "id",
    });
    this.version(3).stores({
      dashboard: "id",
    });
    this.version(4).stores({
      announcementFeeds: "key, updatedAt",
    });
  }
}


// Instance singleton utilisable côté client uniquement
let dbInstance: SyndicProDatabase | null = null;

export function getOfflineDB(): SyndicProDatabase {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    // Si appelé côté serveur (SSR), on retourne un proxy vide sécurisé
    return new Proxy({} as SyndicProDatabase, {
      get() {
        return undefined;
      },
    });
  }
  if (!dbInstance) {
    dbInstance = new SyndicProDatabase();
  }
  return dbInstance;
}

/**
 * Enregistre le profil utilisateur dans Dexie à la connexion réussie.
 */
export async function saveOfflineSession(profile: OfflineSessionProfile): Promise<void> {
  const db = getOfflineDB();
  if (db.session) {
    await db.session.put(profile);
  }
}

/**
 * Récupère le profil utilisateur actif en cache Dexie (utile en mode hors-ligne).
 */
export async function getOfflineSession(): Promise<OfflineSessionProfile | undefined> {
  const db = getOfflineDB();
  if (!db.session) return undefined;
  const sessions = await db.session.toArray();
  const session = sessions[0];
  if (!session) return undefined;
  // Vérifie si la session offline a expiré
  if (session.expiresAt && session.expiresAt < Date.now()) {
    await db.session.clear();
    return undefined;
  }
  return session;
}

/**
 * Supprime la session offline lors de la déconnexion.
 */
export async function clearOfflineSession(): Promise<void> {
  const db = getOfflineDB();
  if (db.session) {
    await db.session.clear();
  }
}

/**
 * Vide TOUTES les tables Dexie (données, session, dashboard, et optionnellement outbox).
 */
export async function clearAllOfflineData(clearOutbox = true): Promise<void> {
  const db = getOfflineDB();
  const tasks: Promise<void>[] = [];
  if (db.residences) tasks.push(db.residences.clear());
  if (db.apartments) tasks.push(db.apartments.clear());
  if (db.charges) tasks.push(db.charges.clear());
  if (db.announcements) tasks.push(db.announcements.clear());
  if (db.incidents) tasks.push(db.incidents.clear());
  if (db.documents) tasks.push(db.documents.clear());
  if (db.session) tasks.push(db.session.clear());
  if (db.dashboard) tasks.push(db.dashboard.clear());
  if (db.announcementFeeds) tasks.push(db.announcementFeeds.clear());
  if (clearOutbox && db.outbox) tasks.push(db.outbox.clear());
  await Promise.all(tasks);
}
````

### `lib/offline/sync.ts`

````ts
import { getOfflineDB } from "./db";
import type { IncidentDTO, PaymentDTO } from "@/types/api";

type SyncListener = (syncing: boolean, pendingCount: number) => void;
const listeners: Set<SyncListener> = new Set();

export function onSyncChange(listener: SyncListener) {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

function notifySync(syncing: boolean, count: number) {
  listeners.forEach((l) => l(syncing, count));
}

type SessionExpiredListener = (message: string) => void;
const sessionExpiredListeners: Set<SessionExpiredListener> = new Set();

export function onSessionExpired(listener: SessionExpiredListener) {
  sessionExpiredListeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    sessionExpiredListeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

export function notifySessionExpired(message = "Session expirée, reconnectez-vous pour synchroniser") {
  sessionExpiredListeners.forEach((l) => l(message));
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("syndicpro:session-expired", { detail: { message } }));
  }
}

let isSyncInProgress = false;

/**
 * Rejoue toutes les requêtes en attente dans la file Outbox Dexie.
 * Déclenché lors du retour de connexion, au chargement de l'app ou manuellement.
 */
export async function syncOutbox(): Promise<{ processed: number; errors: number }> {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return { processed: 0, errors: 0 };
  if (!navigator.onLine) return { processed: 0, errors: 0 };
  if (isSyncInProgress) return { processed: 0, errors: 0 };

  const db = getOfflineDB();
  const { getOfflineSession } = await import("./db");
  const currentSession = await getOfflineSession();

  const pendingItems = await db.outbox
    .where("status")
    .anyOf(["pending", "failed"])
    .sortBy("createdAt");

  if (pendingItems.length === 0) {
    notifySync(false, 0);
    return { processed: 0, errors: 0 };
  }

  isSyncInProgress = true;
  notifySync(true, pendingItems.length);

  let processed = 0;
  let errors = 0;

  for (const item of pendingItems) {
    // Ignore et ne rejoue jamais les éléments dont userId diffère de la session courante
    if (item.userId && (!currentSession?.id || item.userId !== currentSession.id)) {
      continue;
    }

    try {
      await db.outbox.update(item.id, { status: "syncing" });

      const isDelete = item.method === "DELETE";
      const response = await fetch(item.url, {
        method: item.method,
        headers: isDelete ? undefined : { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: isDelete ? undefined : JSON.stringify(item.payload),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

        // Mise à jour du cache local suite au succès serveur
        if (item.entity === "incident") {
          const serverIncident = data as IncidentDTO;
          await db.incidents.put({
            ...serverIncident,
            pending: false,
          });
        } else if (item.entity === "payment") {
          const payment = data as PaymentDTO;
          // Évite le double comptage : recalcule à partir des données serveur au lieu d'ajouter le montant
          try {
            const chargeRes = await fetch(`/api/charges/${payment.charge}`);
            if (chargeRes.ok) {
              const chargeData = await chargeRes.json();
              const chargeToStore =
                chargeData && typeof chargeData === "object" && "data" in chargeData
                  ? chargeData.data
                  : chargeData;
              if (chargeToStore && chargeToStore._id) {
                await db.charges.put(chargeToStore);
              }
            }
          } catch {
            // Ignorer si échec réseau temporaire
          }
        }

        // Supprime l'élément de la file d'attente
        await db.outbox.delete(item.id);
        processed++;
      } else if (response.status === 401) {
        // Point critique H4 : JWT expiré lors de la synchro
        // On remet l'élément en 'pending' (PAS 'failed') pour qu'aucune donnée ne soit perdue
        await db.outbox.update(item.id, { status: "pending" });
        notifySessionExpired("Session expirée, reconnectez-vous pour synchroniser");
        
        // Redirection vers login avec conservation de la page courante
        const currentPath = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
        window.location.href = `/login?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(currentPath)}`;
        break; // Arrête la boucle de synchro
      } else {
        const errText = await response.text();
        await db.outbox.update(item.id, {
          status: "failed",
          retries: item.retries + 1,
          error: `Erreur serveur (${response.status}): ${errText.slice(0, 100)}`,
        });
        errors++;
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const errorMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Erreur réseau";
      await db.outbox.update(item.id, {
        status: "failed",
        retries: item.retries + 1,
        error: errorMsg,
      });
      errors++;
      if (!navigator.onLine) break;
    }
  }

  isSyncInProgress = false;
  const remaining = await db.outbox.where("status").anyOf(["pending", "failed"]).count();
  notifySync(false, remaining);

  return { processed, errors };
}

/**
 * Initialise les écouteurs de reprise de connectivité pour déclencher
 * automatiquement la synchronisation.
 */
export function initAutoSync() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

  window.addEventListener("online", () => {
    console.log("[Sync] Réseau rétabli, lancement de syncOutbox()...");
    syncOutbox();
  });

  if (navigator.onLine) {
    syncOutbox();
  }
}
````

### `lib/password.ts`

````ts
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";

const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;

/**
 * Hache un mot de passe en clair avec bcryptjs (10 tours de sel).
 * Ne jamais afficher ou loguer le mot de passe en clair.
 */
export async function hashPassword(password: string): Promise<string> {
  return bcrypt.hash(password, SALT_ROUNDS);
}

/**
 * Vérifie un mot de passe en clair contre un hash bcrypt.
 */
export async function verifyPassword(password: string, hash: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return bcrypt.compare(password, hash);
}
````
